items.title: 拚一年從零到造出原型機？韓媒：三星進入人形機器人領域 明年1月CES首秀
items.title_en: From Zero to Prototype in One Year? Samsung Enters Humanoid Robot Field, Debuts at CES in January
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，三星電子正加快人形機器人原型機開發，目標是在明年1月於美國拉斯維加斯舉行的消費電子展(CES 2027)上，首次公開自主研發的人形機器人。
《首爾經濟日報(SED)》報導，業內人士透露，在三星電子DX部門負責人Roh Tae-moon直屬管轄下，三星機器人RX部門正主導籌備將於CES 2027登場的樣機。
業內高層人士說：「隨著AI技術的持續演進，人形機器人的商業化落地時間有望大幅提前，三星正因此全面加速開發。」
據悉，三星DX 部門技術長兼總裁Janghyun Yoon正同時掛帥機器人RX部門旗下的硬體與AI軟體兩大研發團隊，全力推進產品迭代。
報導指出，在業界由單一核心主管統籌掌管負責機械驅動的硬體團隊與負責感知決策的AI軟體團隊，這一情形極為罕見。
三星內部與業界普遍認為，在研發初期便將掌管機器人「AI軟體大腦」與「硬體本體」的技術負責人合而為一，是三星意在全面壓縮研發週期的戰略佈局。究其原因，若繼續沿用軟硬體分別獨立研發再行拼裝的傳統模式，根本無法跟上目前AI技術的指數級演進速度。
為加速人形機器人的商業化落地，三星已密集佈局並鎖定多項核心專利，涵蓋人形機器人運動骨架核心的髖關節設計技術、下一代高靈巧度機械手及基於AI的運動控制技術。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that Samsung Electronics is accelerating development of a humanoid robot prototype, aiming to publicly unveil its self‑developed humanoid robot for the first time at the Consumer Electronics Show (CES 2027) in Las Vegas next January.

The Seoul Economic Daily reported that industry insiders say Samsung’s Robot RX division, under the direct supervision of Roh Tae‑moon, head of Samsung Electronics’ DX department, is leading the preparation of the sample model that will appear at CES 2027.

Industry executives said, “As AI technology continues to evolve, the commercial rollout timeline for humanoid robots is expected to be dramatically accelerated, and Samsung is therefore speeding up development across the board.”

It is reported that Janghyun Yoon, chief technology officer and president of Samsung’s DX division, is simultaneously heading both the hardware and AI software R&D teams within the Robot RX division, pushing product iteration forward with full force.

The report notes that it is extremely rare in the industry for a single senior executive to oversee both the hardware team responsible for mechanical drive and the AI software team responsible for perception and decision‑making.

Samsung’s internal and industry consensus is that merging the technical leaders who control the robot’s “AI software brain” and its “hardware body” at the early stage of development is a strategic move to compress the R&D cycle, because continuing the traditional approach of developing hardware and software separately and then assembling them cannot keep pace with the exponential speed of current AI advances.

To accelerate the commercialization of humanoid robots, Samsung has been intensively filing and securing multiple core patents covering hip‑joint design technology for the robot’s motion skeleton, next‑generation highly dexterous mechanical hands, and AI‑based motion control technology.

items.title: 美債是AI泡沫的「終極殺手」？機構：10年期殖利率破5%或成引爆點
paras: 過去300年每次重大泡沫都終結於核心企業借貸成本顯著上升，然而美國本輪債務擴張的核心卻在政府，這項結構性差異可能改變過去「企業去槓桿」主導泡沫破裂的模式，也讓10年期美國公債殖利率是否突破「5%」門檻成為左右人工智慧（AI）熱潮能否延續的重要指標。
洛克菲勒國際（Rockefeller International）董事長 Ruchir Sharma 在《金融時報》撰文指出，美國聯邦政府債務已突破40兆美元，10年期美債殖利率約4.8%。若殖利率進一步「決定性突破5%」，觸及網際網路泡沫時代以來的重要區間上緣，可能成為AI泡沫破裂的導火線。
Sharma 認為，政府以高利率發行大量債券所產生的「擠出效應」，正逐步推高AI企業取得債券及股權融資的成本。
目前AI應用每年營收估計約2000億美元，相較之下，資料中心等相關基礎設施支出已超過1兆美元，兩者之間存在龐大落差，而這項資金缺口高度仰賴外部融資。一旦長天期利率快速攀升，可能直接影響AI產業持續擴大投資的速度。

本輪債務過剩集中政府　AI泡沫結構出現變化

Sharma 回顧過去300年的重大資產泡沫指出，泡沫通常在核心企業的借貸成本大幅上升後走向破裂。從19世紀鐵路泡沫，到現代央行體系下的歷次市場泡沫，都可看到類似模式。
一般而言，市場狂熱期間，企業會大量舉債押注熱門產業或投資題材，隨著通膨及利率攀升，融資成本上升最終刺破泡沫；之後政府才介入，透過承接債務及刺激經濟來穩定市場。
但Sharma認為，這一次的情況有所不同。
自2020年代以來，美國財政赤字持續約占GDP的6%，超過此前數十年的平均水準一倍以上。與此同時，美國家庭及企業長期並未大幅增加槓桿。
直到過去一年，隨著科技巨頭逐漸消耗手中現金盈餘，才開始透過大規模舉債支應龐大的AI基礎建設投資。不過，以這些大型企業的規模而言，目前槓桿水準仍處於可控範圍。
Sharma指出，因此本輪週期真正大幅累積的債務，目前主要集中在政府部門，而風險可能正從負債最嚴重的地方開始浮現。

政府發債產生擠出效應　10年期美債5%成重要關卡

隨著政府債務快速膨脹，美國債券市場的「擠出效應」也開始受到關注。
美國公共債務未償餘額已達40.05兆美元，首次突破40兆美元；本財政年度利息支出達1.17兆美元。與此同時，30年期美債殖利率升至5.32%，創2007年以來新高。
過去5年，美國公共債務利息支出已翻倍至超過GDP的3%，不僅創下美國紀錄，也是主要已開發經濟體中增幅最快、占比最高的國家。
財政壓力與能源價格上漲，進一步推高全球債券殖利率，而無風險利率走高，也會同步增加AI企業的融資成本。AI產業目前正是新發公司債的重要需求來源之一。
Sharma因此將10年期美債殖利率視為關鍵觀察指標。他認為，一旦殖利率「決定性突破5%」，將代表更高利率環境進一步確立，AI大型投資計畫的融資難度也會隨之升高。
當大型科技企業必須與殖利率超過5%、通膨調整後報酬率超過2.5%的政府公債競逐資金時，部分企業可能難以繼續從債券市場取得所需資金。

AI營收遠低於基礎建設支出　融資缺口成市場隱憂

目前AI應用年營收估計僅約2000億美元，遠低於資料中心等基礎設施超過1兆美元的投資規模。AI企業因此愈來愈需要透過新發債券及股票融資填補資金缺口。
然而，10年期美債殖利率若突破5%，可能同時對債券及股票兩大融資管道形成壓力；此外，該殖利率也將高於美股的盈餘殖利率，歷史上通常不利於股市表現。
若10年期美債殖利率在11月前突破5%，代表半年內上升超過75個基點，而歷史上類似幅度的殖利率快速攀升，都曾終結牛市。
儘管部分分析師認為，殖利率突破5%只代表回到1990年代的水準，當時10年期美債殖利率長期高於5%，美股仍維持強勁表現；但Sharma認為，當時美國的債務結構與如今截然不同。
1990年代的美國以財政盈餘結束10年，而目前美國公眾持有的政府債務已接近GDP的100%，償債成本也遠高於當時。因此，公共部門借貸成本上升，可能更迅速擠壓其他借款人，並對估值已大幅擴張的AI市場形成更大壓力。
在此背景下，後續市場將關注10年期美債殖利率是否、以及以多快速度突破5%，以及利率變化可能對AI資本支出與美股估值帶來的衝擊。

items.title: 美債恐比想像更糟 頂尖經濟學家：殖利率已進入「全面應戰」狀態
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Worsens More Than Expected, Top Economist Says Yields Have Entered a “Full‑Scale Battle” State
paras: 美國公債市場近期浮現令人不安的跡象。布魯金斯學會資深研究員布魯克斯（Robin Brooks）指出，殖利率上升顯示，市場情勢可能比表面看來更加嚴峻。
布魯克斯周二在 Substack 發文表示，美國政策目前已將重點放在防止長期借貸成本急升，並提到美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）正努力將公債買回規模提高一倍。
經濟轉弱 殖利率不降反升
他進一步指出，近期反映經濟活動疲弱的數據，並未像過去一樣帶動長期殖利率下滑，凸顯市場本身的上行壓力有多大。
布魯克斯寫道：「就我所見，長期殖利率已進入各方全面應戰的局面。」
儘管上周五公布的就業報告意外優於預期，但布魯克斯表示，過去一個月其他經濟數據大多不如預期。照理說，市場應因經濟放緩及通膨降溫而推低殖利率，但實際上，殖利率卻持續攀升。
不可否認，美國對伊朗的戰事近幾周也持續升溫。隨著衝突加劇，外交談判又未見進展，油價重新走高，使通膨前景更加惡化。
不過，布魯克斯認為，10 年期美債殖利率的異常走勢，其實透露出「市場對美國公債的需求，比表面看來更為疲弱」。
美國債務規模如今已達 40 兆美元，正逐漸超越人工智慧（AI）熱潮，成為華爾街關注焦點。債務疑慮也不僅限於美國，英國、法國、德國及日本等主要經濟體的公債殖利率同樣大幅攀升。
自新冠疫情以來，各國政府持續支出，彷彿借貸成本仍處於危機時期的低點，並任由財政赤字惡化，彷彿經濟仍亟需緊急刺激措施。
然而，如今的經濟環境已截然不同。為抑制高通膨，利率近年大幅攀升；與此同時，AI 熱潮每年為經濟注入數千億美元資金，使經濟對高利率的敏感度愈來愈低。
RSM 首席經濟學家布魯塞拉斯（Joseph Brusuelas）上月在報告中表示：「債務何時會變得不可持續？當全球金融市場這麼認定時。現在看來，這種情況似乎正在發生。」
傳統買家退場 美債波動加劇
同一時間，美債買方結構也已改變。過去為資金尋找安全停泊處的外國央行及其他機構，在美債市場中的角色逐漸縮小，並愈來愈多轉向黃金等替代性避險資產。
全球最大主權財富基金、管理資產達 2.3 兆美元的挪威銀行投資管理公司（Norges Bank Investment Management），已提議調整債券配置，降低對美債的依賴。
隨著傳統美債買家退場，避險基金已成為市場重要參與者，但這類投資人對價格更加敏感，也加劇債市波動。
這意味著，美國財政部必須提供更具吸引力的殖利率，才能讓債券投資人持續進場。在年度預算赤字朝 2 兆美元邁進、國會議員又未展現控制赤字意願之際，市場對於繼續以如此龐大規模借錢給美國聯邦政府，已日益感到不安。
布魯克斯認為，殖利率與經濟數據脫鉤，背後有一個「顯而易見的解釋」，也就是市場更加關注財政赤字前景，因此推升長期利率。
他補充表示：「美債市場的內在動態，比你想像的更令人憂心。」
不過，也有人將殖利率上升解讀為經濟強勁的跡象。華爾街資深策略師亞德尼（Ed Yardeni）不認同債務危機即將爆發的警告，反而認為殖利率只是回歸全球金融危機及新冠疫情前的正常水準；這兩場危機曾開啟超低利率時代。
亞德尼近日在報告中補充，當前美國債務的發展軌跡確實不可持續，但所謂的「債券義警」似乎尚未對此感到憂慮，至少目前還沒有。
亞德尼預測：「美債殖利率仍處於大致符合經濟健康狀況的區間，我們預期 10 年期美債殖利率將維持在 4.00% 至 5.00% 之間。」
paras_en: The U.S. Treasury market has recently shown unsettling signs. Robin Brooks, a senior researcher at the Brookings Institution, points out that rising yields indicate the market situation may be tougher than it appears on the surface.

Brooks wrote on Substack on Tuesday that current U.S. policy is focused on preventing a sharp jump in long‑term borrowing costs, and noted that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is working to double the scale of Treasury buybacks.
Economic slowdown: Yields rise instead of falling

He further noted that recent data reflecting weak economic activity have not driven long‑term yields down as they have in the past, highlighting how strong the upward pressure from the market itself is.
Brooks wrote: “From what I see, long‑term yields have entered a situation where all sides are fully engaged in a battle.”

Even though last Friday’s jobs report came out better than expected, Brooks says most other economic data over the past month have missed forecasts. In theory, a slowing economy and cooling inflation should push yields lower, but in reality yields keep climbing.

It cannot be denied that U.S. hostilities with Iran have also been heating up in recent weeks. As the conflict intensifies and diplomatic talks stall, oil prices have risen again, worsening the inflation outlook.
Nevertheless, Brooks believes the anomalous movement of the 10‑year Treasury yield actually reveals that “the market’s demand for U.S. Treasuries is weaker than it appears on the surface.”

U.S. debt now stands at $40 trillion, gradually overtaking the AI boom as Wall Street’s focal point. Debt concerns are not limited to the United States; major economies such as the United Kingdom, France, Germany and Japan are also seeing their sovereign yields climb sharply.

Since the COVID‑19 pandemic, governments worldwide have kept spending, as if borrowing costs remain at crisis‑low levels, allowing fiscal deficits to worsen, as if economies still urgently need stimulus measures.

However, today’s economic environment is entirely different. To curb high inflation, rates have risen sharply in recent years; at the same time, the AI boom injects hundreds of billions of dollars into the economy each year, making the economy less sensitive to high rates.

Joseph Brusuelas, chief economist at RSM, said in a report last month: “When will debt become unsustainable? When the global financial markets collectively decide so. It now appears that this is happening.”
Traditional buyers are exiting, increasing Treasury volatility

At the same time, the structure of Treasury buyers has shifted. Foreign central banks and other institutions that once sought safe havens are shrinking their role in the Treasury market and increasingly turning to alternatives such as gold.
Norges Bank Investment Management, the world’s largest sovereign wealth fund with $2.3 trillion in assets, has proposed adjusting its bond allocation to reduce reliance on U.S. Treasuries.
As traditional Treasury buyers exit, hedge funds have become key market participants, but these investors are more price‑sensitive, amplifying bond‑market volatility.

This means the Treasury Department must offer more attractive yields to keep investors buying. With the annual budget deficit moving toward $2 trillion and Congress showing little willingness to curb the deficit, the market is growing increasingly uneasy about continuing to lend such massive sums to the U.S. federal government.
Brooks says the decoupling of yields from economic data has an “obvious explanation”: the market is focusing more on the fiscal‑deficit outlook, which pushes long‑term rates higher.
He added: “The underlying dynamics of the Treasury market are more concerning than you think.”

However, some interpret the rise in yields as a sign of a strong economy. Wall Street veteran strategist Ed Yardeni disagrees with warnings of an imminent debt crisis, arguing instead that yields are simply returning to pre‑COVID‑19 and pre‑global‑financial‑crisis normal levels, which had ushered in an era of ultra‑low rates.
Yardeni recently added in a report that while the current trajectory of U.S. debt is indeed unsustainable, the so‑called “bond vigilantes” do not yet appear worried about it, at least not for now.
Yardeni predicts: “Treasury yields remain broadly in line with a healthy economy; we expect the 10‑year Treasury yield to stay between 4.00% and 5.00%.”

items.title: 〈能源盤後〉美伊衝突擴大 荷姆茲海峽通行量創5月來新低 油價衝上六週高點 Brent逼近98美元
items.title_en: Energy After-Hours: US-Iran Conflict Escalates, Hormuz Strait Traffic Hits May Low, Oil Prices Reach Six-Week High as Brent Nears $98
paras: 國際油價周一(7日)升至六週高點，布蘭特原油一度逼近每桶98美元，主因美伊雙方持續攻擊油輪與軍艦，伊朗更警告將報復性打擊中東能源基礎設施，使市場進一步擔憂荷姆茲海峽運輸受阻，全球石油供應缺口恐持續擴大。
布蘭特原油期貨上漲1.03美元或1.1%，收在每桶97.31美元，盤中最高觸及98.06美元，創7月24日以來最高。由於美國適逢勞動節假期，布蘭特原油期貨周一提前約1小時、於美東時間下午1時30分(格林威治時間17時30分)結算。
美國西德州中級原油(WTI)期貨則因美國假期周一不結算，截至美東時間下午1時45分上漲1.17美元或1.3%，報每桶92.65美元，盤中一度升至93.29美元，同樣創7月24日以來最高。
油價上漲反映市場對中東能源供應風險迅速升高的擔憂。伊朗國會議長卡利巴夫周一警告，「攻擊我們的資產，就會遭到攻擊」，被視為回應美國國防部長赫格塞斯此前宣稱伊朗石油船隊「毫無防備」的言論。
美伊雙方周末進一步擴大對油輪與軍艦的攻擊。海事情報公司Marisks指出，美國與伊朗針對商業船舶的攻擊，已成為雙方施加經濟壓力的工具，使過去軍事衝突與商業航運之間的界線進一步模糊。
此次戰事始於2月28日美國與以色列對伊朗發動攻擊，近期雙方恢復直接交火後，能源供應受到更大衝擊。布蘭特原油上周累計上漲約8%，WTI則大漲近10%，各國為避免供應不足，正持續消耗原油庫存。
美國是全球最大石油生產國與消費國，但PVM Energy分析師指出，美國汽油及餾分油庫存目前均顯著低於去年同期與過去5年季節性平均水準，顯示能源市場的緩衝空間正在縮小。分析師形容，目前供應狀況比數周前評估時更加嚴峻。
中東其他地區的軍事衝突也同步升溫。黎巴嫩衛生部表示，以色列周一對黎巴嫩南部一座城鎮發動攻擊，造成至少12人死亡，成為近幾周最致命的轟炸行動之一。
沙烏地阿拉伯能源設施也傳出遭到攻擊。Saudi Aramco旗下Jazan煉油廠周一遭到攻擊，目前損害程度仍在評估中。Jazan煉油廠位於沙烏地西南部、靠近葉門邊境，產能約每日40萬桶，此次事件距離上次遭到攻擊僅約1個月，進一步加劇市場對波斯灣能源基礎設施安全的擔憂。
此外，一艘沙烏地籍油輪一周前遭伊朗攻擊，沙烏地方面表示有2名船員死亡。阿曼周一則表示，已從該油輪撤離16名船員，反映商業航運受到軍事衝突影響的程度正在擴大。
荷姆茲海峽的船舶通行量也明顯下降。航運與大宗商品數據分析公司Kpler數據顯示，過去10天平均每天僅約10艘大宗商品船舶通過荷姆茲海峽，為5月以來最低水準。市場擔心，如果油輪通行量進一步大幅下降，全球石油供應可能出現更嚴重的衝擊。
Phillip Nova市場洞察主管Priyanka Sachdeva表示，如果油輪交通開始出現實質性放緩，市場可能迅速反映更大的供應衝擊，而目前已經出現相關跡象。荷姆茲海峽是全球最重要的能源運輸通道之一，任何長時間的航運中斷，都可能使油價面臨急劇上行壓力。
高盛則警告，如果針對中東航運的攻擊持續升級，油價最高可能攀升至每桶120美元。高盛全球大宗商品研究聯席主管Daan Struyven表示，近幾天的事件顯示，航運中斷擴大與加劇的風險正在成為重要市場風險。
伊朗方面也進一步提高對荷姆茲海峽的管控威脅。伊朗最高國家安全委員會秘書Mohsen Rezaei表示，伊朗預計未來幾天將宣布在荷姆茲海峽外海設立限制區，市場因此更加擔心全球能源運輸可能受到進一步限制。
面對航運與能源出口風險升高，阿拉伯聯合大公國正建立替代能源出口與貿易路線。阿聯總統顧問Anwar Gargash表示，該國將確保能源出口與貿易活動不會因美伊戰爭而「遭到挾持」，顯示波斯灣產油國正積極降低對荷姆茲海峽的依賴。
供應端方面，OPEC+周日會議決定維持10月石油生產政策不變。產油國集團表示，在決定下一步產量政策之前，仍需要先就新的生產配額達成協議，因此目前並未進一步調整10月產量政策。
油市目前正同時面臨供應下降、航運受阻、能源設施遭襲以及戰事擴大的多重風險。若荷姆茲海峽的油輪通行量持續處於低檔，且中東能源設施遭到更多攻擊，市場可能進一步擴大對供應短缺的定價，油價突破每桶100美元的風險也將明顯升高。
paras_en: International oil prices rose on Monday (the 7th) to a six‑week high, with Brent crude briefly approaching $98 a barrel. The surge was driven by continued attacks by the United States and Iran on tankers and warships, and Iran’s warning of retaliatory strikes on Middle‑East energy infrastructure, which heightened market fears of disrupted Hormuz Strait shipping and a widening global oil supply gap.

Brent crude futures rose $1.03, or 1.1%, to $97.31 a barrel, touching a intraday high of $98.06 – the highest since July 24. Because the United States observed the Labor Day holiday, Brent settled about an hour early on Monday at 1:30 p.m. Eastern Time (17:30 GMT).

U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures were not settled on the holiday Monday; as of 1:45 p.m. Eastern Time they were up $1.17, or 1.3%, at $92.65 a barrel, having peaked at $93.29 intraday – also the highest since July 24.

The price rise reflects market anxiety over rapidly escalating Middle‑East energy‑supply risks. Iran’s parliament speaker, Ali Larijani, warned on Monday that “attacking our assets will invite retaliation,” a statement seen as a response to U.S. Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin’s earlier claim that Iran’s oil fleet was “undefended.”

Both sides expanded attacks on tankers and warships over the weekend. Maritime intelligence firm Marisks said that U.S. and Iranian attacks on commercial vessels have become tools for economic pressure, further blurring the line between military conflict and commercial shipping.

The latest hostilities trace back to the Feb. 28 U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran. After recent direct exchanges resumed, energy supplies have been hit harder. Brent rose about 8% last week, while WTI surged nearly 10%, prompting countries to draw down crude inventories to guard against shortages.

The United States is the world’s largest oil producer and consumer, but PVM Energy analysts note that U.S. gasoline and distillate stocks are now markedly below both year‑ago levels and the five‑year seasonal averages, indicating shrinking market buffers. Analysts say the supply picture is now tougher than assessments made a few weeks ago.

Military clashes are also heating up elsewhere in the Middle East. Lebanon’s health ministry reported that Israel bombed a town in southern Lebanon on Monday, killing at least 12 people – one of the deadliest attacks in recent weeks.

Saudi Arabia’s energy facilities have also come under fire. A Saudi Aramco‑owned refinery in Jazan was attacked on Monday; damage assessments are ongoing. The Jazan plant, located in southwest Saudi near the Yemen border, processes about 400,000 barrels per day, and this incident follows an attack roughly a month earlier, heightening concerns over the security of Persian Gulf energy infrastructure.

In addition, a Saudi‑flagged tanker was hit by Iran a week earlier, killing two crew members, according to Saudi officials. Oman said on Monday it had evacuated 16 crew from the vessel, underscoring the expanding impact of the conflict on commercial shipping.

Traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has fallen sharply. Data from shipping and bulk‑commodity analytics firm Kpler show an average of only about 10 bulk‑carrier vessels per day passed the strait over the past ten days – the lowest level since May. Markets fear that a further drop in tanker traffic could cause a more severe shock to global oil supplies.

Phillip Nova market‑insights head Priyanka Sachdeva warned that if tanker traffic begins to slow materially, markets could quickly price in a larger supply shock, and she sees early signs of that already. The Hormuz Strait is one of the world’s most critical energy corridors, and any prolonged shipping disruption could push oil prices sharply higher.

Goldman Sachs cautioned that if attacks on Middle‑East shipping continue to intensify, oil could climb as high as $120 a barrel. Co‑head of Goldman’s global commodities research, Daan Struyven, said recent events show that the risk of expanding and worsening shipping disruptions is becoming a key market risk.

Iran also raised its threat level over Hormuz. Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, said Iran expects to announce a restriction zone in the waters off Hormuz in the coming days, prompting further market worries that global energy transport could face additional limits.

Facing heightened shipping and energy‑export risks, the United Arab Emirates is developing alternative export and trade routes. UAE presidential adviser Anwar Gargash said the country will ensure its energy exports and trade are not “held hostage” by the U.S.–Iran war, reflecting Gulf producers’ push to reduce reliance on the Hormuz Strait.

On the supply side, OPEC+ kept its October production policy unchanged at its Sunday meeting. The producer group said it still needs to reach an agreement on new production quotas before deciding on any further adjustments to October output.

The oil market now confronts multiple risks: falling supply, shipping disruptions, attacks on energy facilities and an expanding war. If Hormuz tanker traffic remains low and Middle‑East energy sites face more attacks, markets could further price in supply shortages, raising the odds of oil breaking $100 a barrel.

paras_en: Pre‑market Taiwan stock news for September 8.

1. On the 7th, the Taiwan index surged as TSMC rallied and MediaTek rose more than half a percent before hitting the limit up. UMC surged to its limit up as well, helping the index close up 775.14 points, or 1.67%, at 47,326.27 points with a turnover of NT$9.399 trillion. Foreign investors added another NT$883.07 billion, marking the fourth‑largest net purchase in Taiwan market history. Both TSMC and UMC were favored, and several active ETFs were also bought.

2. Realtek (2379‑TW), a major IC design firm, saw its chairman Chiu Shun‑chien awarded the 15th Academia of Industrial Technology fellowship on the 7th. In an interview he said Realtek continues to expand into advanced processes and AI, with its ASIC now progressing to a 3‑nm node, and that ongoing collaborations with Nvidia (NVDA‑TW) and other global leaders make high‑speed interfaces and switches promising areas for Taiwan’s IC design industry.

3. Boosted by a strong Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, the Taiwan market on the 7th was led by electronics stocks to retake the 47,000‑point level. Taiwan ETFs performed strongly as well: the benchmark ETF 0050 rose 1.85%, just under a 2% gain from its recent high; Fubon Technology (0052‑TW), which holds over 60% of TSMC, also climbed 1.67%; and the tech‑sector leader ETF 0053 surged 1.91%, the most impressive gain.

4. Hanheng (2634‑TW) announced on the 7th that it has signed a strategic cooperation agreement with Canadian aerospace group Bombardier for the Challenger 3500 business jet (CL3500) cockpit and forward fuselage structures. The contract spans a 20‑year full‑life term and represents the most significant recent development in Hanheng’s civil‑aviation business.

5. MediaTek (2454‑TW) shares have been climbing for several days, briefly hitting the limit‑up price on the 7th. Taiwan ETFs that hold MediaTek are now under close market scrutiny. More than 60 Taiwan ETFs currently own MediaTek stock; among the ten ETFs with the largest MediaTek holdings, eight have delivered returns above the market average over the past month, including dividend yields.

6. Memory‑module maker Winbond (3260‑TW) posted August revenue of NT$18.93 billion, setting a new monthly record with a 2.97% month‑over‑month increase and a 279.81% year‑over‑year rise. This marks the sixth consecutive month of record‑breaking sales, and cumulative revenue for the first eight months of the year surpassed NT$100 billion, reaching NT$101.58 billion – a new milestone since the company’s founding.
Post‑market Taiwan stock note: TSMC, together with UMC, led a bullish rally that lifted the index by 775 points to close at 47,326 points.
Foreign investors recorded the fourth‑largest net purchase ever, injecting NT$883 billion and heavily buying AU Optronics and TSMC while trimming positions in the “Five Electronics Giants.”
Weight‑stock groups surged: ETF 0053 jumped nearly 2% ahead of its split, and ETF 0050 approached a new high.
Strict crackdown on illicit production sites: the Finance and Economic Ministries jointly investigated 257 cases, imposing fines of NT$600,000 per false “MIT” certificate.
Hanheng’s civil‑aviation business makes a new breakthrough, securing a 20‑year contract for Bombardier’s CL3500.
Nvidia’s large‑scale investment boosts several Taiwan ETFs that follow “MediaTek” (the “Fa‑Ge” nickname), making them especially popular.
New Academia of Industrial Technology fellow: Realtek lands 3‑nm ASIC orders and sees two key Taiwanese sectors as worthy investment targets.
No shift to short positions: foreign investors bought over 310,000 contracts of 00403A in a single week, positioning for a high‑end rotation market.
Securities and bond dealers profit on both fronts: Guo Piao Jin’s August profit rebounded, earning NT$3.3 billion in the first eight months, a record for the period.
Wistron NeWeb’s expansion benefits are materializing, with August revenue hitting NT$1.7 billion, a new high.
Winbond’s August revenue of NT$18.9 billion continues the upward trend, pushing cumulative revenue for the first eight months past the NT$100 billion mark.

items.title: 8.3兆美元的市場發出警訊 「川普牛市」恐正如履薄冰
items.title_en: $8.3 Trillion Market Warning: The “Trump Bull Market” May Be on Thin Ice
paras: 儘管川普在社群上發文，他透過股票及其他資產，已經為美國賺進「數千億美元」，但他指揮的美股牛市背後，一個高達8.3兆美元的歷史級警訊正在悄悄浮現，顯示華爾街的多頭市場可能已如履薄冰。

市場對川普投顧信心現裂痕

回顧歷史，川普在第一任期內，道瓊、標普500和那斯達克指數分別大幅上漲57%、70%及142%。而在第二任期內，截至2026年9月2日，三大指數也再度揚升22%、28%與34%。
儘管帳面耀眼，但投資人的實際行動卻顯得格外謹慎。財經專欄作家Sean Williams指出，即使美國聯準會(Fed)在2024年9月至2025年12月期間連續降息6次，導致固定收益證券的殖利率下滑，傳統上應該會促使資金回流股市，但事實卻完全相反。

貨幣市場基金規模創紀錄

根據聯準會最新數據，第一季持有在「貨幣市場基金」中的總金融資產，已持續升至8.29兆美元的歷史新高。自2022年中期以來，此類資產規模已暴漲了65%。
Williams分析，貨幣市場基金主要投資於極安全的短期國庫券及定期存單(CD)，旨在保障本金並賺取穩定利息。在降息引導殖利率下降的情況下，資金仍瘋狂湧入此避險工具，反映出市場對「川普牛市」的高度懷疑，這批龐大資金並未如預期般回流股市。

估值過高、AI泡沫與融資餘額的三重隱憂

Williams點出三大紅線，解釋了為何投資人寧可抱著貨幣基金，也不願投入股市：
第一，美股估值過高：美股在2026年初迎來了近156年歷史上的「第二高」昂貴估值，歷史經驗顯示超高估值在長期內是難以持續的。
第二，AI泡沫化的疑慮：此輪牛市由AI革命催生，但Williams提醒，過去半世紀以來，每項變革性科技在初期都經歷過早期泡沫破裂階段，貨幣基金資產暴增正是防範AI泡沫破滅的布局。
第三，創紀錄的融資餘額：融資餘額(Outstanding Margin Debt)已創下歷史新高，進一步加劇了市場下行的風險。

歷史警訊：資金湧入多為股市崩盤前兆

過去50多年的歷史表明，貨幣基金資產的大幅攀升，往往是經濟衰退與股市崩盤的前兆。
Williams強調，在2008年金融海嘯以及2020年新冠疫情崩盤前夕，市場都曾出現過類似的資金瘋狂避險現象。這份高達8.3兆美元的警戒信號，正提醒投資人必須為隨時可能到來的逆風做好防範準備。
paras_en: Despite Trump’s social‑media posts and the billions of dollars he has allegedly earned for the United States through stocks and other assets, a historic $8.3 trillion warning signal is quietly emerging behind the bull market he commands, suggesting that Wall Street’s rally may be on thin ice.

Market confidence in Trump‑led investment advice is cracking. Historically, during Trump’s first term the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq rose 57%, 70% and 142% respectively. In his second term, as of September 2, 2026 the three major indices have again climbed 22%, 28% and 34%.

Even though the headline numbers look dazzling, investors’ actual behavior is unusually cautious. Financial columnist Sean Williams notes that even though the Federal Reserve cut rates six times between September 2024 and December 2025, lowering bond yields – which traditionally would push money back into equities – the opposite has happened.
Money‑market‑fund assets hit a record. According to the latest Fed data, total financial assets held in money‑market funds rose to a historic $8.29 trillion in Q1, up 65% since mid‑2022.

Williams explains that money‑market funds mainly invest in ultra‑safe short‑term Treasury bills and certificates of deposit to preserve principal and earn steady interest. Even as rate cuts drive yields down, money has poured into these safe‑haven vehicles, reflecting deep skepticism about the “Trump bull market” and showing that the massive cash has not returned to stocks as expected.
Three red‑flags: overvaluation, an AI bubble and record margin debt. Williams points to three major concerns that explain why investors prefer money‑market funds over equities:

First, U.S. equities are overvalued. At the start of 2026 the market reached the second‑highest valuation in the past 156 years, and history shows such extreme levels are unsustainable over the long term.

Second, worries about an AI bubble. This rally is driven by the AI revolution, but Williams warns that every transformative technology in the past half‑century has gone through an early‑stage bubble burst, and the surge in money‑market assets is a hedge against a potential AI bust.
Third, record‑high outstanding margin debt, which further amplifies downside risk for the market.

Historical warning: inflows into money‑market funds often precede market crashes. Over the past five decades, sharp rises in money‑market assets have frequently signaled upcoming recessions and equity market collapses.

Williams stresses that similar frantic safe‑haven flows occurred before the 2008 financial crisis and the 2020 COVID‑19 market crash. The $8.3 trillion warning signal is a reminder that investors must brace for possible headwinds at any time.

items.title: 美國「K型經濟」現反轉訊號？低所得家庭8月薪資成長罕見超越高所得
items.title_en: Is the U.S. “K-shaped Economy” Reversing? Low‑Income Households’ August Wage Growth Rarely Surpasses High‑Income
paras: 根據美國銀行最新的消費者存款帳戶數據，長期以來高所得與低所得家庭之間失衡的「K型」薪資成長狀況，可能正面臨轉變。
數據顯示，低所得家庭上個月的薪資年增率達到 4.7%，明顯高於高所得家庭的 3.5%。此一薪資差距縮小的趨勢，是在整體勞動力市場輕微降溫的背景下發生的，整體就業人數年增率從 7 月的 1.8% 降至約 1.5%。
美銀資深經濟學家David Michael Tinsley在報告中指出，高低所得家庭在稅後薪資成長上的長期「K型」走勢已經發生逆轉。雖然這波反轉是否能長期持續，仍面臨不確定性，但低所得勞工似乎正在逐步收復失地。
Tinsley分析，這波逆襲的部分原因，可歸功於《單一美好法案》(OBBBA)實施後扣繳稅額降低所帶來的稅後薪資提升，但低薪勞工市場本身的強勁表現更扮演了重要角色。
數據顯示，7 月份的換職率明顯高於 2025 年(但略低於 2022 年的大離職潮)，其中又以每周領薪的時薪人員換職率年增幅最大。由於換職通常會迎來加薪，這成為上個月縮減各所得族群薪資成長差距的主因。
此趨勢也引發政府高層關注。美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)上個月接受 CNBC 專訪時，便明確宣告「K型經濟已經結束」。他指出，當前經濟更呈現出「C型經濟」的特徵，代表底層的薪資收入者終於在經濟體系中追回失地、逐步奪回劣勢。
paras_en: According to the latest consumer deposit account data from Bank of America, the long‑standing “K‑shaped” wage growth imbalance between high‑ and low‑income households in the United States may be shifting.

The data show that low‑income families saw an annual wage growth rate of 4.7% last month, clearly above the 3.5% recorded for high‑income families. This narrowing wage gap is occurring against a backdrop of a modest cooling in the overall labor market, with total employment’s annual growth rate falling from 1.8% in July to about 1.5%.

Bank of America senior economist David Michael Tinsley noted in the report that the long‑term “K‑shaped” trajectory of after‑tax wage growth for high‑ and low‑income households has reversed. While the durability of this reversal remains uncertain, low‑income workers appear to be gradually regaining ground.

Tinsley explained that part of this comeback can be attributed to higher after‑tax pay resulting from reduced withholding under the One‑Bill‑Better‑America Act (OBBBA), but the strong performance of the low‑wage labor market itself also plays a key role.

The figures reveal that July’s job‑switching rate was markedly higher than in 2025 (though slightly below the massive turnover seen in 2022), with hourly workers paid weekly showing the largest year‑over‑year increase in switching. Because job changes often bring pay raises, this was the main driver behind the reduced wage‑growth gap between income groups last month.

The trend has drawn attention from senior government officials. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC last month that the “K‑shaped economy is over.” He said the current economy now shows “C‑shaped” characteristics, indicating that lower‑wage earners are finally reclaiming lost ground and gradually overcoming their disadvantage.

items.title: 美債是AI泡沫的「終極殺手」？機構：10年期殖利率破5%或成引爆點
paras: 過去300年每次重大泡沫都終結於核心企業借貸成本顯著上升，然而美國本輪債務擴張的核心卻在政府，這項結構性差異可能改變過去「企業去槓桿」主導泡沫破裂的模式，也讓10年期美國公債殖利率是否突破「5%」門檻成為左右人工智慧（AI）熱潮能否延續的重要指標。
洛克菲勒國際（Rockefeller International）董事長 Ruchir Sharma 在《金融時報》撰文指出，美國聯邦政府債務已突破40兆美元，10年期美債殖利率約4.8%。若殖利率進一步「決定性突破5%」，觸及網際網路泡沫時代以來的重要區間上緣，可能成為AI泡沫破裂的導火線。
Sharma 認為，政府以高利率發行大量債券所產生的「擠出效應」，正逐步推高AI企業取得債券及股權融資的成本。
目前AI應用每年營收估計約2000億美元，相較之下，資料中心等相關基礎設施支出已超過1兆美元，兩者之間存在龐大落差，而這項資金缺口高度仰賴外部融資。一旦長天期利率快速攀升，可能直接影響AI產業持續擴大投資的速度。

本輪債務過剩集中政府　AI泡沫結構出現變化

Sharma 回顧過去300年的重大資產泡沫指出，泡沫通常在核心企業的借貸成本大幅上升後走向破裂。從19世紀鐵路泡沫，到現代央行體系下的歷次市場泡沫，都可看到類似模式。
一般而言，市場狂熱期間，企業會大量舉債押注熱門產業或投資題材，隨著通膨及利率攀升，融資成本上升最終刺破泡沫；之後政府才介入，透過承接債務及刺激經濟來穩定市場。
但Sharma認為，這一次的情況有所不同。
自2020年代以來，美國財政赤字持續約占GDP的6%，超過此前數十年的平均水準一倍以上。與此同時，美國家庭及企業長期並未大幅增加槓桿。
直到過去一年，隨著科技巨頭逐漸消耗手中現金盈餘，才開始透過大規模舉債支應龐大的AI基礎建設投資。不過，以這些大型企業的規模而言，目前槓桿水準仍處於可控範圍。
Sharma指出，因此本輪週期真正大幅累積的債務，目前主要集中在政府部門，而風險可能正從負債最嚴重的地方開始浮現。

政府發債產生擠出效應　10年期美債5%成重要關卡

隨著政府債務快速膨脹，美國債券市場的「擠出效應」也開始受到關注。
美國公共債務未償餘額已達40.05兆美元，首次突破40兆美元；本財政年度利息支出達1.17兆美元。與此同時，30年期美債殖利率升至5.32%，創2007年以來新高。
過去5年，美國公共債務利息支出已翻倍至超過GDP的3%，不僅創下美國紀錄，也是主要已開發經濟體中增幅最快、占比最高的國家。
財政壓力與能源價格上漲，進一步推高全球債券殖利率，而無風險利率走高，也會同步增加AI企業的融資成本。AI產業目前正是新發公司債的重要需求來源之一。
Sharma因此將10年期美債殖利率視為關鍵觀察指標。他認為，一旦殖利率「決定性突破5%」，將代表更高利率環境進一步確立，AI大型投資計畫的融資難度也會隨之升高。
當大型科技企業必須與殖利率超過5%、通膨調整後報酬率超過2.5%的政府公債競逐資金時，部分企業可能難以繼續從債券市場取得所需資金。

AI營收遠低於基礎建設支出　融資缺口成市場隱憂

目前AI應用年營收估計僅約2000億美元，遠低於資料中心等基礎設施超過1兆美元的投資規模。AI企業因此愈來愈需要透過新發債券及股票融資填補資金缺口。
然而，10年期美債殖利率若突破5%，可能同時對債券及股票兩大融資管道形成壓力；此外，該殖利率也將高於美股的盈餘殖利率，歷史上通常不利於股市表現。
若10年期美債殖利率在11月前突破5%，代表半年內上升超過75個基點，而歷史上類似幅度的殖利率快速攀升，都曾終結牛市。
儘管部分分析師認為，殖利率突破5%只代表回到1990年代的水準，當時10年期美債殖利率長期高於5%，美股仍維持強勁表現；但Sharma認為，當時美國的債務結構與如今截然不同。
1990年代的美國以財政盈餘結束10年，而目前美國公眾持有的政府債務已接近GDP的100%，償債成本也遠高於當時。因此，公共部門借貸成本上升，可能更迅速擠壓其他借款人，並對估值已大幅擴張的AI市場形成更大壓力。
在此背景下，後續市場將關注10年期美債殖利率是否、以及以多快速度突破5%，以及利率變化可能對AI資本支出與美股估值帶來的衝擊。

items.title: 美債恐比想像更糟 頂尖經濟學家：殖利率已進入「全面應戰」狀態
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Worsens More Than Expected, Top Economist Says Yields Have Entered a “Full‑Scale Battle” State
paras: 美國公債市場近期浮現令人不安的跡象。布魯金斯學會資深研究員布魯克斯（Robin Brooks）指出，殖利率上升顯示，市場情勢可能比表面看來更加嚴峻。
布魯克斯周二在 Substack 發文表示，美國政策目前已將重點放在防止長期借貸成本急升，並提到美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）正努力將公債買回規模提高一倍。
經濟轉弱 殖利率不降反升
他進一步指出，近期反映經濟活動疲弱的數據，並未像過去一樣帶動長期殖利率下滑，凸顯市場本身的上行壓力有多大。
布魯克斯寫道：「就我所見，長期殖利率已進入各方全面應戰的局面。」
儘管上周五公布的就業報告意外優於預期，但布魯克斯表示，過去一個月其他經濟數據大多不如預期。照理說，市場應因經濟放緩及通膨降溫而推低殖利率，但實際上，殖利率卻持續攀升。
不可否認，美國對伊朗的戰事近幾周也持續升溫。隨著衝突加劇，外交談判又未見進展，油價重新走高，使通膨前景更加惡化。
不過，布魯克斯認為，10 年期美債殖利率的異常走勢，其實透露出「市場對美國公債的需求，比表面看來更為疲弱」。
美國債務規模如今已達 40 兆美元，正逐漸超越人工智慧（AI）熱潮，成為華爾街關注焦點。債務疑慮也不僅限於美國，英國、法國、德國及日本等主要經濟體的公債殖利率同樣大幅攀升。
自新冠疫情以來，各國政府持續支出，彷彿借貸成本仍處於危機時期的低點，並任由財政赤字惡化，彷彿經濟仍亟需緊急刺激措施。
然而，如今的經濟環境已截然不同。為抑制高通膨，利率近年大幅攀升；與此同時，AI 熱潮每年為經濟注入數千億美元資金，使經濟對高利率的敏感度愈來愈低。
RSM 首席經濟學家布魯塞拉斯（Joseph Brusuelas）上月在報告中表示：「債務何時會變得不可持續？當全球金融市場這麼認定時。現在看來，這種情況似乎正在發生。」
傳統買家退場 美債波動加劇
同一時間，美債買方結構也已改變。過去為資金尋找安全停泊處的外國央行及其他機構，在美債市場中的角色逐漸縮小，並愈來愈多轉向黃金等替代性避險資產。
全球最大主權財富基金、管理資產達 2.3 兆美元的挪威銀行投資管理公司（Norges Bank Investment Management），已提議調整債券配置，降低對美債的依賴。
隨著傳統美債買家退場，避險基金已成為市場重要參與者，但這類投資人對價格更加敏感，也加劇債市波動。
這意味著，美國財政部必須提供更具吸引力的殖利率，才能讓債券投資人持續進場。在年度預算赤字朝 2 兆美元邁進、國會議員又未展現控制赤字意願之際，市場對於繼續以如此龐大規模借錢給美國聯邦政府，已日益感到不安。
布魯克斯認為，殖利率與經濟數據脫鉤，背後有一個「顯而易見的解釋」，也就是市場更加關注財政赤字前景，因此推升長期利率。
他補充表示：「美債市場的內在動態，比你想像的更令人憂心。」
不過，也有人將殖利率上升解讀為經濟強勁的跡象。華爾街資深策略師亞德尼（Ed Yardeni）不認同債務危機即將爆發的警告，反而認為殖利率只是回歸全球金融危機及新冠疫情前的正常水準；這兩場危機曾開啟超低利率時代。
亞德尼近日在報告中補充，當前美國債務的發展軌跡確實不可持續，但所謂的「債券義警」似乎尚未對此感到憂慮，至少目前還沒有。
亞德尼預測：「美債殖利率仍處於大致符合經濟健康狀況的區間，我們預期 10 年期美債殖利率將維持在 4.00% 至 5.00% 之間。」
paras_en: The U.S. Treasury market has recently shown unsettling signs. Robin Brooks, a senior researcher at the Brookings Institution, points out that rising yields indicate the market situation may be tougher than it appears on the surface.

Brooks wrote on Substack on Tuesday that current U.S. policy is focused on preventing a sharp jump in long‑term borrowing costs, and noted that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is working to double the scale of Treasury buybacks.
Economic slowdown: Yields rise instead of falling

He further noted that recent data reflecting weak economic activity have not driven long‑term yields down as they have in the past, highlighting how strong the upward pressure from the market itself is.
Brooks wrote: “From what I see, long‑term yields have entered a situation where all sides are fully engaged in a battle.”

Even though last Friday’s jobs report came out better than expected, Brooks says most other economic data over the past month have missed forecasts. In theory, a slowing economy and cooling inflation should push yields lower, but in reality yields keep climbing.

It cannot be denied that U.S. hostilities with Iran have also been heating up in recent weeks. As the conflict intensifies and diplomatic talks stall, oil prices have risen again, worsening the inflation outlook.
Nevertheless, Brooks believes the anomalous movement of the 10‑year Treasury yield actually reveals that “the market’s demand for U.S. Treasuries is weaker than it appears on the surface.”

U.S. debt now stands at $40 trillion, gradually overtaking the AI boom as Wall Street’s focal point. Debt concerns are not limited to the United States; major economies such as the United Kingdom, France, Germany and Japan are also seeing their sovereign yields climb sharply.

Since the COVID‑19 pandemic, governments worldwide have kept spending, as if borrowing costs remain at crisis‑low levels, allowing fiscal deficits to worsen, as if economies still urgently need stimulus measures.

However, today’s economic environment is entirely different. To curb high inflation, rates have risen sharply in recent years; at the same time, the AI boom injects hundreds of billions of dollars into the economy each year, making the economy less sensitive to high rates.

Joseph Brusuelas, chief economist at RSM, said in a report last month: “When will debt become unsustainable? When the global financial markets collectively decide so. It now appears that this is happening.”
Traditional buyers are exiting, increasing Treasury volatility

At the same time, the structure of Treasury buyers has shifted. Foreign central banks and other institutions that once sought safe havens are shrinking their role in the Treasury market and increasingly turning to alternatives such as gold.
Norges Bank Investment Management, the world’s largest sovereign wealth fund with $2.3 trillion in assets, has proposed adjusting its bond allocation to reduce reliance on U.S. Treasuries.
As traditional Treasury buyers exit, hedge funds have become key market participants, but these investors are more price‑sensitive, amplifying bond‑market volatility.

This means the Treasury Department must offer more attractive yields to keep investors buying. With the annual budget deficit moving toward $2 trillion and Congress showing little willingness to curb the deficit, the market is growing increasingly uneasy about continuing to lend such massive sums to the U.S. federal government.
Brooks says the decoupling of yields from economic data has an “obvious explanation”: the market is focusing more on the fiscal‑deficit outlook, which pushes long‑term rates higher.
He added: “The underlying dynamics of the Treasury market are more concerning than you think.”

However, some interpret the rise in yields as a sign of a strong economy. Wall Street veteran strategist Ed Yardeni disagrees with warnings of an imminent debt crisis, arguing instead that yields are simply returning to pre‑COVID‑19 and pre‑global‑financial‑crisis normal levels, which had ushered in an era of ultra‑low rates.
Yardeni recently added in a report that while the current trajectory of U.S. debt is indeed unsustainable, the so‑called “bond vigilantes” do not yet appear worried about it, at least not for now.
Yardeni predicts: “Treasury yields remain broadly in line with a healthy economy; we expect the 10‑year Treasury yield to stay between 4.00% and 5.00%.”

items.title: 4支科技股進入標普100指數 Nike遭剔除 18年輝煌紀錄告終
items.title_en: Four Tech Stocks Enter S&P 100 Index as Nike Is Removed, Ending an 18-Year Streak
paras: 標普道瓊指數公司宣布，全球運動鞋巨頭 Nike(NKE-US) 將於 9 月 21 日美股開盤前被正式剔除出標普 100 指數，結束其將近 18 年的輝煌紀錄。儘管 Nike 仍將保留在更廣泛的標普 500 指數中，但這項重大調整，也象徵著其市場主導地位已面臨根本性的動搖。
在此次季度調整中，高露潔(CL-US)、Simon 地產集團(SPG-US)和Honeywell航太(HONA-US)也將退出標普 100 指數，空缺則由戴爾(DELL-US)、Palo Alto Networks (PANW-US)、Arista Networks (ANET-US) 及 SanDisk (SNDK-US)等4家科技與 AI 基礎設施公司接替，反映出指數向科技業傾斜的趨勢。
Nike 股價在 9 月 4 日跌至 38.40 美元，創下近 12 年來新低，相較於 2021 年底的紀錄高點已慘跌約 78% 至 79%。這場長達5年的衰退，使其市值慘重蒸發超過 2,200 億美元，目前市值僅剩約 570 億美元。其 2026 財年營收為 464 億美元，表現近乎停滯，而被寄予厚望的 Nike Direct 直營業務與數位營收則分別下滑 6% 與 12%。
分析指出，Nike 的困境在於其過度激進的直營(DTC)戰略。此舉削減了與批發通路(如 Foot Locker 等)的合作夥伴關係，大幅減少與新消費者的觸點。同時，Nike 產品創新力不足，過度依賴經典鞋款(如 Air Force 1、AJ1)的換色重刻，加上通路為清庫存而進行折扣戰，嚴重蠶食了品牌的溢價空間。
在關鍵的大中華市場，Nike 2026 財年營收按本幣計算重挫 11% 至 13%，除了安踏、李寧等中國本土品牌崛起搶占份額外，On 和 Hoka 等新興高性能跑鞋品牌也正在全球快速蠶食其份額。
儘管現任執行長 Elliott Hill 承諾推動全面改革，著手重建零售商關係並控制庫存，但市場分析師認為其營收復甦及創新成效仍顯緩慢。
paras_en: S&P Dow Jones Indices announced that global sneaker giant Nike (NKE-US) will be formally removed from the S&P 100 index before the market opens on September 21, ending its nearly 18‑year run. Nike will remain in the broader S&P 500, but the move signals a fundamental shake‑up of its market dominance.

In this quarterly reshuffle, Colgate (CL-US), Simon Property Group (SPG-US) and Honeywell Aerospace (HONA-US) will also exit the S&P 100, making way for four technology and AI‑infrastructure firms – Dell (DELL-US), Palo Alto Networks (PANW-US), Arista Networks (ANET-US) and SanDisk (SNDK-US) – reflecting the index’s tilt toward tech.

Nike’s share price fell to $38.40 on September 4, a 12‑year low, roughly a 78‑79% drop from its record high at the end of 2021. The five‑year decline has erased more than $220 billion of market value, leaving a market cap of about $57 billion. Fiscal 2026 revenue was $46.4 billion, essentially flat, while the much‑hyped Nike Direct business and digital sales fell 6% and 12% respectively.

Analysts say Nike’s woes stem from an overly aggressive direct‑to‑consumer (DTC) strategy that has strained relationships with wholesale partners such as Foot Locker, cutting off many consumer touchpoints. In addition, product innovation has lagged, with the brand leaning heavily on color‑way refreshes of classics like the Air Force 1 and AJ1, while discounting to clear inventory has eroded its pricing power.

In the crucial Greater China market, Nike’s fiscal 2026 revenue in local currency fell 11%‑13% as domestic rivals Anta and Li‑Ning gained share and emerging performance‑running brands such as On and Hoka rapidly ate into its market globally.

Although current CEO Elliott Hill has pledged a sweeping reform, rebuilding retailer relationships and tightening inventory, market analysts say revenue recovery and innovation progress remain sluggish.

items.title: 8.3兆美元的市場發出警訊 「川普牛市」恐正如履薄冰
items.title_en: $8.3 Trillion Market Warning: The “Trump Bull Market” May Be on Thin Ice
paras: 儘管川普在社群上發文，他透過股票及其他資產，已經為美國賺進「數千億美元」，但他指揮的美股牛市背後，一個高達8.3兆美元的歷史級警訊正在悄悄浮現，顯示華爾街的多頭市場可能已如履薄冰。

市場對川普投顧信心現裂痕

回顧歷史，川普在第一任期內，道瓊、標普500和那斯達克指數分別大幅上漲57%、70%及142%。而在第二任期內，截至2026年9月2日，三大指數也再度揚升22%、28%與34%。
儘管帳面耀眼，但投資人的實際行動卻顯得格外謹慎。財經專欄作家Sean Williams指出，即使美國聯準會(Fed)在2024年9月至2025年12月期間連續降息6次，導致固定收益證券的殖利率下滑，傳統上應該會促使資金回流股市，但事實卻完全相反。

貨幣市場基金規模創紀錄

根據聯準會最新數據，第一季持有在「貨幣市場基金」中的總金融資產，已持續升至8.29兆美元的歷史新高。自2022年中期以來，此類資產規模已暴漲了65%。
Williams分析，貨幣市場基金主要投資於極安全的短期國庫券及定期存單(CD)，旨在保障本金並賺取穩定利息。在降息引導殖利率下降的情況下，資金仍瘋狂湧入此避險工具，反映出市場對「川普牛市」的高度懷疑，這批龐大資金並未如預期般回流股市。

估值過高、AI泡沫與融資餘額的三重隱憂

Williams點出三大紅線，解釋了為何投資人寧可抱著貨幣基金，也不願投入股市：
第一，美股估值過高：美股在2026年初迎來了近156年歷史上的「第二高」昂貴估值，歷史經驗顯示超高估值在長期內是難以持續的。
第二，AI泡沫化的疑慮：此輪牛市由AI革命催生，但Williams提醒，過去半世紀以來，每項變革性科技在初期都經歷過早期泡沫破裂階段，貨幣基金資產暴增正是防範AI泡沫破滅的布局。
第三，創紀錄的融資餘額：融資餘額(Outstanding Margin Debt)已創下歷史新高，進一步加劇了市場下行的風險。

歷史警訊：資金湧入多為股市崩盤前兆

過去50多年的歷史表明，貨幣基金資產的大幅攀升，往往是經濟衰退與股市崩盤的前兆。
Williams強調，在2008年金融海嘯以及2020年新冠疫情崩盤前夕，市場都曾出現過類似的資金瘋狂避險現象。這份高達8.3兆美元的警戒信號，正提醒投資人必須為隨時可能到來的逆風做好防範準備。
paras_en: Despite Trump’s social‑media posts and the billions of dollars he has allegedly earned for the United States through stocks and other assets, a historic $8.3 trillion warning signal is quietly emerging behind the bull market he commands, suggesting that Wall Street’s rally may be on thin ice.

Market confidence in Trump‑led investment advice is cracking. Historically, during Trump’s first term the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq rose 57%, 70% and 142% respectively. In his second term, as of September 2, 2026 the three major indices have again climbed 22%, 28% and 34%.

Even though the headline numbers look dazzling, investors’ actual behavior is unusually cautious. Financial columnist Sean Williams notes that even though the Federal Reserve cut rates six times between September 2024 and December 2025, lowering bond yields – which traditionally would push money back into equities – the opposite has happened.
Money‑market‑fund assets hit a record. According to the latest Fed data, total financial assets held in money‑market funds rose to a historic $8.29 trillion in Q1, up 65% since mid‑2022.

Williams explains that money‑market funds mainly invest in ultra‑safe short‑term Treasury bills and certificates of deposit to preserve principal and earn steady interest. Even as rate cuts drive yields down, money has poured into these safe‑haven vehicles, reflecting deep skepticism about the “Trump bull market” and showing that the massive cash has not returned to stocks as expected.
Three red‑flags: overvaluation, an AI bubble and record margin debt. Williams points to three major concerns that explain why investors prefer money‑market funds over equities:

First, U.S. equities are overvalued. At the start of 2026 the market reached the second‑highest valuation in the past 156 years, and history shows such extreme levels are unsustainable over the long term.

Second, worries about an AI bubble. This rally is driven by the AI revolution, but Williams warns that every transformative technology in the past half‑century has gone through an early‑stage bubble burst, and the surge in money‑market assets is a hedge against a potential AI bust.
Third, record‑high outstanding margin debt, which further amplifies downside risk for the market.

Historical warning: inflows into money‑market funds often precede market crashes. Over the past five decades, sharp rises in money‑market assets have frequently signaled upcoming recessions and equity market collapses.

Williams stresses that similar frantic safe‑haven flows occurred before the 2008 financial crisis and the 2020 COVID‑19 market crash. The $8.3 trillion warning signal is a reminder that investors must brace for possible headwinds at any time.

items.title: 美國「K型經濟」現反轉訊號？低所得家庭8月薪資成長罕見超越高所得
items.title_en: Is the U.S. “K-shaped Economy” Reversing? Low‑Income Households’ August Wage Growth Rarely Surpasses High‑Income
paras: 根據美國銀行最新的消費者存款帳戶數據，長期以來高所得與低所得家庭之間失衡的「K型」薪資成長狀況，可能正面臨轉變。
數據顯示，低所得家庭上個月的薪資年增率達到 4.7%，明顯高於高所得家庭的 3.5%。此一薪資差距縮小的趨勢，是在整體勞動力市場輕微降溫的背景下發生的，整體就業人數年增率從 7 月的 1.8% 降至約 1.5%。
美銀資深經濟學家David Michael Tinsley在報告中指出，高低所得家庭在稅後薪資成長上的長期「K型」走勢已經發生逆轉。雖然這波反轉是否能長期持續，仍面臨不確定性，但低所得勞工似乎正在逐步收復失地。
Tinsley分析，這波逆襲的部分原因，可歸功於《單一美好法案》(OBBBA)實施後扣繳稅額降低所帶來的稅後薪資提升，但低薪勞工市場本身的強勁表現更扮演了重要角色。
數據顯示，7 月份的換職率明顯高於 2025 年(但略低於 2022 年的大離職潮)，其中又以每周領薪的時薪人員換職率年增幅最大。由於換職通常會迎來加薪，這成為上個月縮減各所得族群薪資成長差距的主因。
此趨勢也引發政府高層關注。美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)上個月接受 CNBC 專訪時，便明確宣告「K型經濟已經結束」。他指出，當前經濟更呈現出「C型經濟」的特徵，代表底層的薪資收入者終於在經濟體系中追回失地、逐步奪回劣勢。
paras_en: According to the latest consumer deposit account data from Bank of America, the long‑standing “K‑shaped” wage growth imbalance between high‑ and low‑income households in the United States may be shifting.

The data show that low‑income families saw an annual wage growth rate of 4.7% last month, clearly above the 3.5% recorded for high‑income families. This narrowing wage gap is occurring against a backdrop of a modest cooling in the overall labor market, with total employment’s annual growth rate falling from 1.8% in July to about 1.5%.

Bank of America senior economist David Michael Tinsley noted in the report that the long‑term “K‑shaped” trajectory of after‑tax wage growth for high‑ and low‑income households has reversed. While the durability of this reversal remains uncertain, low‑income workers appear to be gradually regaining ground.

Tinsley explained that part of this comeback can be attributed to higher after‑tax pay resulting from reduced withholding under the One‑Bill‑Better‑America Act (OBBBA), but the strong performance of the low‑wage labor market itself also plays a key role.

The figures reveal that July’s job‑switching rate was markedly higher than in 2025 (though slightly below the massive turnover seen in 2022), with hourly workers paid weekly showing the largest year‑over‑year increase in switching. Because job changes often bring pay raises, this was the main driver behind the reduced wage‑growth gap between income groups last month.

The trend has drawn attention from senior government officials. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC last month that the “K‑shaped economy is over.” He said the current economy now shows “C‑shaped” characteristics, indicating that lower‑wage earners are finally reclaiming lost ground and gradually overcoming their disadvantage.

items.title: 終於忍不住炫耀？川普社群狂發貼文與AI操盤圖 宣稱為美賺進數千億
items.title_en: Finally Can't Resist Boasting? Trump’s Social Media Flood of AI-Generated Charts Claims He Earned Tens of Billions for the U.S.
paras: 美國總統川普周日(6日)展開了一場長達 10 多個小時的社群媒體「洗版」行動。他在其創立的Truth Social平台上發布了至少 37 篇貼文，內容充斥著大量的AI生成圖像。他還配文指出，自己已經為美國在股票及其他資產上賺取了數千億美元。
在這些貼文中，最引人注目的是一張川普在白宮橢圓形辦公室內「親自操盤」的 AI 圖像。圖像中的川普盯著四個螢幕，畫面上顯示晶片大廠英特爾(INTC-US)的股價從 20 美元飆升至 95 美元。
川普在圖中配文寫道：「我是為了國家而做，而非自己。我已經為美國在股票及其他資產上賺取了數千億美元，但我得到的卻只有激進左派『蠢貨』民主黨人的批評。非常不公平，但又能怎麼辦呢！」
然而，這張以英特爾為主角的圖像隨即引發了道德爭議。根據政府倫理辦公室(OGE)的申報資料，川普的個人投資帳戶在 2026 年第一季便進行了超過 3,600 次股票交易，總價值逾 1 億美元，其中就包含數度買進英特爾股票。與此同時，美國政府本身也持有英特爾 10% 的股權。
儘管白宮強調這些交易皆由投資機構獨立管理，川普並未直接干涉，但川普在 2025 年個人賺取至少 22 億美元的財務申報曝光後，反對者質疑他正利用總統職權牟利。
面對這類質疑，川普在受訪時反駁表示，他的個人財富皆是由金融顧問投資，他根本不與他們交談。川普強調：「這應該就是所謂的『盲目帳戶』(blind account)……我之所以獲利，是因為股市在上漲，大家都在獲利。」
不過，蓋洛普(Gallup)上周發布的民調顯示，已有高達 90% 的美國民眾認為美國政府和政治領袖存在腐敗問題，這也讓川普的發言備受檢視。
此外，川普「真實社群」推出的「真實 API」(Truth API)服務也面臨調查。該服務每月收取 10 萬美元，能讓訂閱者提早獲取可能影響金融市場的政策宣布資訊。對此，美國參議員已敦促證券交易委員會(SEC)調查此舉是否違反聯邦證券法。
川普媒體臨時執行長麥格恩(Kevin McGurn)對此回應，這項服務純粹是「市場向我們提出的需求」。
除了股市議題，川普當天的洗版貼文還涉及了極具爭議的國際政局與領土宣稱。他發布了多張美伊戰爭的 AI 生成圖，包含伊朗哈爾克島(Kharg Island)爆炸、戰艦起火等畫面；川普甚至分享了將新墨西哥州改名為「新美國」、宣布「月球是我們的」，以及將美加邊境的安大略湖改名為「美國湖」的圖像。
對此，加拿大總理馬克·卡尼(Mark Carney)已公開回絕，表示加拿大「將會繼續稱其為安大略湖」。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump launched a marathon "spam" campaign on social media on Sunday (the 6th), posting at least 37 messages on his Truth Social platform over more than ten hours, many of which were filled with AI‑generated images. He added that he has earned the United States tens of billions of dollars in stocks and other assets.

The most eye‑catching post was an AI picture showing Trump "personally trading" inside the Oval Office. In the image Trump stares at four screens, one of which displays Intel Corp. (INTC‑US) stock soaring from $20 to $95.

Trump captioned the picture, "I do this for the country, not for myself. I’ve earned the United States tens of billions of dollars in stocks and other assets, but all I get is criticism from radical left‑wing ‘idiot’ Democrats. It’s very unfair, but what can you do about it?!"

The Intel‑focused image quickly sparked an ethics debate. According to filings from the Office of Government Ethics (OGE), Trump’s personal investment account made more than 3,600 stock trades worth over $100 million in the first quarter of 2026, including several purchases of Intel shares. At the same time, the U.S. government itself holds a 10% stake in Intel.

Although the White House stressed that the trades were handled independently by investment firms and Trump did not intervene directly, opponents pointed to his 2025 financial disclosure showing he personally earned at least $2.2 billion and accused him of leveraging the presidency for profit.

When questioned, Trump argued in an interview that his personal wealth is managed by financial advisors and that he never talks to them. He emphasized, "This is what they call a ‘blind account’… I made money because the market went up and everyone profited."
Nevertheless, a Gallup poll released last week showed that as many as 90% of Americans believe the government and political leaders are corrupt, putting Trump’s statements under intense scrutiny.

In addition, Trump’s Truth Social has rolled out a “Truth API” service that is under investigation. The service charges $100,000 per month to give subscribers early access to policy announcements that could move financial markets. U.S. senators have urged the SEC to examine whether the service violates federal securities laws.
Kevin McGurn, the interim CEO of Trump Media, responded that the service simply meets a “market demand” that was presented to them.

Beyond the stock‑market theme, Trump’s flood of posts that day also touched on highly controversial international politics and territorial claims. He shared multiple AI‑generated images of a U.S.–Iran war, including explosions on Iran’s Kharg Island and burning warships, and even posted pictures renaming New Mexico to “New America,” declaring “the Moon is ours,” and renaming Ontario Lake on the U.S.–Canada border to “America Lake.”
In response, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney publicly rejected the idea, stating Canada “will continue to call it Ontario Lake.”

items.title: OpenAI Astra是加速走向失控的「算力怪獸」？能自己操作電腦、思維鏈恐越來越難讀懂
items.title_en: Is OpenAI's Astra a Powering‑Up "Computing Monster" on the Verge of Losing Control? Can It Operate Computers and Think Chains Become Harder to Read?
paras: OpenAI推出新一代旗艦模型GPT-6 Astra，主打讓AI直接操作電腦、執行複雜任務，被公司視為邁向「AGI時代」的重要一步；然而，Astra採用的新架構也引發AI安全疑慮，專家警告，當模型推理過程逐漸難以被人類讀懂，未來AI監控可能面臨更大挑戰。
根據《財富》報導，OpenAI在9月3日發布Astra，其中一項代表性功能為「電腦使用」（Computer Use），讓AI能像人類一樣操作電腦。
OpenAI展示的影片中，使用者透過語音下達指令，AI則完成電腦操作，整體互動過程相對流暢。
OpenAI共同創辦人暨總裁Greg Brockman表示，電腦使用能力是Astra眾多新功能中相當重要的一項，模型可以高速處理試算表、填寫表單及瀏覽網頁。
除了電腦操作外，OpenAI也強調Astra在數學運算、軟體工程與網路安全防禦方面的能力。公司公布的基準測試結果顯示，Astra在多項任務上的表現優於GPT-5.6 Sol及Anthropic的Claude Fable 5.1。
在ARC-AGI-3測試中，Astra得分98.6%，GPT-5.6 Sol為7.8%，Claude Opus 5則為30%；該測試主要用於評估模型面對未見情境時的推理能力。在網路安全挑戰ExploitBench中，Astra則取得滿分，高於GPT-5.6 Sol的78.5%。
Brockman認為，電腦使用能力可能被視為「AGI時代」的開端。他指出，若有人認為目前已經進入AGI時代，這種看法並非毫無道理；甚至將Astra視為第一個AGI，也有其合理性。
不過，AGI的定義至今仍存在爭議。OpenAI過去曾將AGI定義為，能在所有具經濟價值的工作中達到或超越人類水準的自動化系統。
Brockman則表示，AGI並非突然出現，而是逐步累積形成。

Astra初期限縮開放　網路安全能力受到管制

儘管Astra具備直接操作電腦的能力，但OpenAI並未立即全面開放所有功能。公司初期僅向部分企業客戶提供Astra，包括專注網路安全的Daybreak計畫客戶，並計畫在數日內向Plus、Pro及Enterprise用戶開放，同時透過OpenAI API及AWS提供。
OpenAI表示，提供給相關客戶的版本不具備高階網路安全任務能力。
OpenAI發言人指出，Astra屬於規模非常大的模型，初期限制使用範圍，主要是為了逐步擴充計算能力。
OpenAI研究副總裁Aidan Clark則表示，Astra開發涉及公司迄今最大規模的訓練，首次在德州Stargate資料中心使用超過10萬顆GPU進行預訓練。
Astra的推出也與網路安全事件有關。OpenAI在7月Hugging Face遭AI代理入侵事件後延後Astra發布，以增加額外安全措施。此後，公司強化監控並進一步隔離訓練環境，但外界仍質疑新增監控措施是否足夠。
依照美國AI安全框架相關條款，OpenAI在發布Astra前也將模型提交美國政府審查。不過，該框架屬於科技業與川普政府之間的自願性協議，具體內容尚未公開，也不是正式的公開審查程序。
Astra同時成為OpenAI首個達到「關鍵網路安全能力門檻」的模型。這項門檻來自OpenAI內部「準備框架」，公司將依模型可能帶來的風險採取不同安全措施。
OpenAI表示，在適當條件下，Astra能夠在沒有人工監督的情況下發現並利用過去未知的安全漏洞，因此最先進的網路安全能力目前僅向部分合作夥伴開放。

Astra新架構引發疑慮　AI思維鏈恐更難監控

相較於Astra能直接操作電腦所帶來的能力提升，AI安全專家更關注其模型架構可能造成的另一項影響：人類未來是否還能看懂AI究竟是如何進行推理。
Astra部分採用了「循環深度」或「循環Transformer」技術。這種架構可以減少模型處理指令所需的計算資源，提高AI運算效率。
但另一方面，循環式處理也可能讓模型的思維鏈，也就是推理步驟，不再完全以自然語言呈現，使人類難以監控其行為及動機。
這對AI安全而言尤其重要。現階段，思維鏈監控被視為觀察AI代理是否產生意外或未經授權行為的重要方法之一。若模型的推理過程逐漸變得難以閱讀，人類監控其行為與意圖的難度也可能隨之提高。
OpenAI首席科學家Jakub Pachocki表示，公司對思維鏈監控高度重視，自早期推理模型推出以來，OpenAI便持續投入相關研究。他也透露，公司對循環Transformer的使用有所限制，以維持推理過程的可讀性。
Pachocki承認，未來思維鏈監控可能面臨更大的挑戰，但他認為這不一定源自模型架構本身，OpenAI仍可採取措施強化監控，相關工作也是目前研究重點之一。
不過，AI安全領域仍出現反對聲音。
曾任OpenAI安全研究員、現任Guidelight AI Standards負責人的Stephen Adler認為，OpenAI此舉可能踩到AI產業少數重要的安全紅線。
華盛頓特區智庫AI政策網路政策總監Peter Wildford也警告，OpenAI採用循環深度技術可能帶來令人擔憂的後果。
Wildford指出，在7月Hugging Face遭AI代理入侵事件中，OpenAI及外部AI評估公司能夠透過包括讀取模型思維鏈在內的方法，重建部分事件經過。如果未來AI的思維鏈變得更加難以理解，人類可能因此失去重要的監控手段。
前OpenAI治理研究員Daniel Kokotajlo則警告，即使OpenAI未進一步採用讓思維鏈更難理解的架構，其他AI公司仍可能跟進。
他因此呼籲Pachocki推動制定業界通用的思維鏈可監控性標準，避免AI模型推理過程的透明度持續下降。
paras_en: OpenAI has launched a new flagship model, GPT‑6 Astra, marketed as enabling AI to directly operate computers and perform complex tasks, a step the company sees as crucial toward the "AGI era"; however, the new architecture also raises AI safety concerns, with experts warning that as the model’s reasoning process becomes increasingly opaque, future AI monitoring may face greater challenges.
According to a report by Fortune, OpenAI released Astra on September 3, with one representative feature being "Computer Use," allowing the AI to operate a computer like a human.
In the demonstration video, a user issues voice commands and the AI completes computer operations, with the overall interaction process being relatively smooth.

OpenAI co‑founder and president Greg Brockman said that the computer‑use capability is a particularly important feature among Astra’s many new functions, and that the model can process spreadsheets, fill out forms and browse the web at high speed.

In addition to computer operation, OpenAI highlighted Astra’s abilities in mathematics, software engineering and network‑security defense. Benchmark results released by the company show that Astra outperforms GPT‑5.6 Sol and Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5.1 on several tasks.

In the ARC‑AGI‑3 test, Astra scored 98.6%, GPT‑5.6 Sol 7.8% and Claude Opus 5 30%; the test mainly evaluates a model’s reasoning ability in unseen scenarios. In the network‑security challenge ExploitBench, Astra achieved a perfect score, higher than GPT‑5.6 Sol’s 78.5%.

Brockman believes that the computer‑use capability could be seen as the beginning of the "AGI era." He pointed out that if some people think we are already in the AGI era, that view is not without merit; even treating Astra as the first AGI has some rationality.
However, the definition of AGI remains controversial. OpenAI has previously defined AGI as an automated system that can achieve or surpass human performance in all economically valuable work.
Brockman said that AGI does not appear suddenly, but accumulates gradually.

Astra’s initial release was limited, and its network‑security capabilities are regulated. Although Astra can directly operate computers, OpenAI did not immediately open all features. The company initially offered Astra only to a subset of enterprise customers, including those in the Daybreak network‑security program, and plans to open it to Plus, Pro and Enterprise users in a few days, as well as through the OpenAI API and AWS.
OpenAI said that the version provided to relevant customers does not have advanced network‑security task capabilities.
A spokesperson for OpenAI noted that Astra is a very large model, and its early use is limited mainly to gradually expand computing power.

OpenAI research vice president Aidan Clark said that Astra’s development involved the company’s largest training effort to date, using more than 100,000 GPUs at the Stargate data center in Texas for pre‑training.

Astra’s launch is also related to network‑security incidents. After the July Hugging Face AI‑agent intrusion incident, OpenAI delayed Astra’s release to add extra security measures. The company then strengthened monitoring and further isolated the training environment, but outsiders still question whether the added monitoring is sufficient.

According to U.S. AI safety framework provisions, OpenAI also submitted the model to U.S. government review before releasing Astra. However, the framework is a voluntary agreement between the tech industry and the Trump administration, its details are not public, and it is not a formal public review process.

Astra also became OpenAI’s first model to reach the "critical network‑security capability threshold." This threshold comes from OpenAI’s internal "preparation framework," and the company will take different safety measures based on the risks the model may pose.

OpenAI said that under appropriate conditions, Astra can discover and exploit previously unknown security vulnerabilities without human supervision, so the most advanced network‑security capabilities are currently only available to select partners.

Astra’s new architecture raises concerns that AI thinking chains may become harder to monitor. Compared to the capability of directly operating computers, AI safety experts are more concerned about another potential impact of the model’s architecture: whether humans will still be able to understand how AI actually reasons in the future.

Astra partially uses "recurrent depth" or "recurrent Transformer" technology. This architecture can reduce the computational resources required to process commands, improving AI computational efficiency.

On the other hand, recurrent processing may also cause the model’s thinking chain, i.e., reasoning steps, to no longer be fully presented in natural language, making it harder for humans to monitor its behavior and motives.

This is especially important for AI safety. At present, monitoring the thinking chain is considered one of the key methods for observing whether an AI agent produces unintended or unauthorized behavior. If the model’s reasoning process becomes increasingly unreadable, the difficulty for humans to monitor its behavior and intent may also increase.

OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki said the company places high importance on thinking‑chain monitoring, and has continued to invest in related research since the early reasoning model launch. He also revealed that the company has imposed some restrictions on the use of recurrent Transformers to maintain the readability of the reasoning process.

Pachocki acknowledged that future thinking‑chain monitoring may face greater challenges, but he believes this does not necessarily stem from the model architecture itself; OpenAI can still take measures to strengthen monitoring, and this work is also a current research focus.
However, there are still opposing voices in the AI safety field.
Stephen Adler, former OpenAI safety researcher and current head of Guidelight AI Standards, believes that OpenAI’s move may have stepped on a few important safety red lines in the AI industry.
Peter Wildford, director of AI policy at the Washington, D.C. think‑tank AI Policy Network, also warned that OpenAI’s use of recurrent depth technology could lead to concerning consequences.

Wildford pointed out that in the July Hugging Face AI‑agent intrusion incident, OpenAI and external AI assessment companies were able to reconstruct part of the incident by reading the model’s thinking chain. If AI’s thinking chain becomes harder to understand in the future, humans may lose an important monitoring tool.

Former OpenAI governance researcher Daniel Kokotajlo warned that even if OpenAI does not further adopt architectures that make the thinking chain harder to understand, other AI companies may still follow suit.
He therefore called on Pachocki to push for industry‑wide standards for monitoring the thinking chain, to prevent the transparency of AI model reasoning processes from continually declining.

items.title: 美債多空迎關鍵一周 兩大事件恐讓長短債同步劇烈波動
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Bonds Face a Pivotal Week; Two Events Could Trigger Simultaneous Sharp Moves in Short‑ and Long‑Term Yields
paras: 美債投資人正為各期限債券可能出現更劇烈震盪預作準備，本周兩項潛在催化因素，可能同時牽動短天期與長天期美債大幅波動。
美國勞動節長周末結束後，歷經政府債市已相當動盪的一周，交易員將聚焦本周兩項關鍵日程，希望藉此研判美國財政部長貝森特與聯準會（Fed）主席沃許的政策意向。
美國財政部預定周三(9日)公布債券買回細節，並於隔日執行。依據擴大後的計畫，買回規模至少將是原定上限的兩倍，市場甚至認為可能擴大至3至5倍。周五(11日)則將公布最新通膨數據，華許與其他Fed官員已暗示，這項數據將是決定本月是否升息的關鍵。
這兩項事件可能使假期縮短的本周行情更為震盪。投資人仍須應對左右美國利率市場的兩股力量：通常主導短期殖利率的貨幣政策，以及著眼於壓低長期借貸成本的財政政策。
就業數據推升升息預期
美國8月就業成長優於預期後，上周五美債殖利率曲線趨平，短期殖利率走高，長天期債券則大致持穩。交易員因而提高對Fed本月升息的押注，但財政部與Fed政策前景仍不明朗，限制市場波動幅度。
加拿大帝國商業銀行私人財富管理固定收益主管Tim Musial表示，就業報告只是「前菜」，9月11日公布的通膨數據才是「主菜」。他也指出，財政部債券買回有別於經濟成長與通膨等基本面因素，是難以預測的挑戰，「在這種環境下，或許應該稍微降低風險」。
買回規模牽動長債行情
財政部擴大債券買回計畫的消息出乎投資人意料，因為公告時間並不在例行季度融資聲明期間。此前，30年期美債殖利率一度升至2007年以來最高水準，截至上周五仍徘徊在約5.25%的高檔。
財政部表示，買回規模將較先前的20億美元「至少增加一倍」，讓貝森特保留政策調整空間。若實際買回金額超過40億美元，可能帶動美債上漲。
通膨數據成Fed決策關鍵
另一方面，沃許上月在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會發表演說時表示，Fed目前的首要重點應放在物價。彭博調查的經濟學家預估，美國8月消費者物價指數（CPI）將年增3.4%，剔除波動較大的食品與能源後，核心CPI預估年增2.4%。
根據交換市場定價，截至上周五，投資人認為Fed本月升息1碼的機率約為60%。Fed下一次利率決策將於9月16日公布。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury investors are preparing for potentially sharper volatility across bonds of all maturities, as two possible catalysts this week could simultaneously drive large swings in both short‑term and long‑term U.S. Treasuries.

After the Labor Day long weekend, traders will focus on two key dates this week following an already turbulent week in the government bond market, hoping to gauge the policy intentions of Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen and Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell.

The Treasury plans to announce details of a bond buyback on Wednesday (the 9th) and execute it the next day. Under the expanded plan, the buyback size will be at least twice the original cap, with some market participants believing it could be three to five times larger. On Friday (the 11th) the latest inflation data will be released, and Powell and other Fed officials have hinted that this figure will be decisive for whether rates are raised this month.

These two events could make an already compressed trading week even more volatile. Investors will still have to contend with the two forces that drive the U.S. rate market: monetary policy, which typically dominates short‑term yields, and fiscal policy, which aims to keep long‑term borrowing costs low.
Employment data lifts rate‑hike expectations

After August’s employment growth outperformed expectations, the Treasury yield curve flattened last Friday, with short‑term yields rising while long‑term bonds held relatively steady. Traders therefore increased their bets on a Fed rate hike this month, but the outlook for Treasury and Fed policy remains unclear, limiting the magnitude of market moves.

Tim Musial, head of fixed‑income for private wealth at CIBC, said the jobs report was just an "appetizer" and that the inflation data due on September 11 would be the "main course." He also noted that the Treasury’s bond buyback is unrelated to fundamentals such as economic growth and inflation and poses an unpredictable challenge, adding that "in this environment, it may be prudent to dial back risk a bit."
Buyback size influences long‑bond dynamics

The news that the Treasury is expanding its bond buyback program surprised investors because the announcement came outside the regular quarterly financing statements. Earlier, the 30‑year Treasury yield had risen to its highest level since 2007, hovering around 5.25% as of last Friday.

The Treasury said the buyback would be "at least double" the previous $20 billion, giving Secretary Yellen room to adjust policy. If the actual repurchase amount exceeds $40 billion, it could push Treasury prices higher.
Inflation data is key to Fed decisions

Separately, Powell said at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Meeting last month that the Fed’s top priority should be price stability. Bloomberg‑surveyed economists project that U.S. CPI for August will rise 3.4% year‑over‑year, with core CPI—excluding the more volatile food and energy components—expected to increase 2.4% annually.

Based on swap‑market pricing as of last Friday, investors assign roughly a 60% probability that the Fed will raise rates by one quarter‑point this month. The Fed’s next rate decision is scheduled for September 16.

items.title: 拚一年從零到造出原型機？韓媒：三星進入人形機器人領域 明年1月CES首秀
items.title_en: From Zero to Prototype in One Year? Samsung Enters Humanoid Robot Field, Debuts at CES in January
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，三星電子正加快人形機器人原型機開發，目標是在明年1月於美國拉斯維加斯舉行的消費電子展(CES 2027)上，首次公開自主研發的人形機器人。
《首爾經濟日報(SED)》報導，業內人士透露，在三星電子DX部門負責人Roh Tae-moon直屬管轄下，三星機器人RX部門正主導籌備將於CES 2027登場的樣機。
業內高層人士說：「隨著AI技術的持續演進，人形機器人的商業化落地時間有望大幅提前，三星正因此全面加速開發。」
據悉，三星DX 部門技術長兼總裁Janghyun Yoon正同時掛帥機器人RX部門旗下的硬體與AI軟體兩大研發團隊，全力推進產品迭代。
報導指出，在業界由單一核心主管統籌掌管負責機械驅動的硬體團隊與負責感知決策的AI軟體團隊，這一情形極為罕見。
三星內部與業界普遍認為，在研發初期便將掌管機器人「AI軟體大腦」與「硬體本體」的技術負責人合而為一，是三星意在全面壓縮研發週期的戰略佈局。究其原因，若繼續沿用軟硬體分別獨立研發再行拼裝的傳統模式，根本無法跟上目前AI技術的指數級演進速度。
為加速人形機器人的商業化落地，三星已密集佈局並鎖定多項核心專利，涵蓋人形機器人運動骨架核心的髖關節設計技術、下一代高靈巧度機械手及基於AI的運動控制技術。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that Samsung Electronics is accelerating development of a humanoid robot prototype, aiming to publicly unveil its self‑developed humanoid robot for the first time at the Consumer Electronics Show (CES 2027) in Las Vegas next January.

The Seoul Economic Daily reported that industry insiders say Samsung’s Robot RX division, under the direct supervision of Roh Tae‑moon, head of Samsung Electronics’ DX department, is leading the preparation of the sample model that will appear at CES 2027.

Industry executives said, “As AI technology continues to evolve, the commercial rollout timeline for humanoid robots is expected to be dramatically accelerated, and Samsung is therefore speeding up development across the board.”

It is reported that Janghyun Yoon, chief technology officer and president of Samsung’s DX division, is simultaneously heading both the hardware and AI software R&D teams within the Robot RX division, pushing product iteration forward with full force.

The report notes that it is extremely rare in the industry for a single senior executive to oversee both the hardware team responsible for mechanical drive and the AI software team responsible for perception and decision‑making.

Samsung’s internal and industry consensus is that merging the technical leaders who control the robot’s “AI software brain” and its “hardware body” at the early stage of development is a strategic move to compress the R&D cycle, because continuing the traditional approach of developing hardware and software separately and then assembling them cannot keep pace with the exponential speed of current AI advances.

To accelerate the commercialization of humanoid robots, Samsung has been intensively filing and securing multiple core patents covering hip‑joint design technology for the robot’s motion skeleton, next‑generation highly dexterous mechanical hands, and AI‑based motion control technology.

items.title: 美債是AI泡沫的「終極殺手」？機構：10年期殖利率破5%或成引爆點
paras: 過去300年每次重大泡沫都終結於核心企業借貸成本顯著上升，然而美國本輪債務擴張的核心卻在政府，這項結構性差異可能改變過去「企業去槓桿」主導泡沫破裂的模式，也讓10年期美國公債殖利率是否突破「5%」門檻成為左右人工智慧（AI）熱潮能否延續的重要指標。
洛克菲勒國際（Rockefeller International）董事長 Ruchir Sharma 在《金融時報》撰文指出，美國聯邦政府債務已突破40兆美元，10年期美債殖利率約4.8%。若殖利率進一步「決定性突破5%」，觸及網際網路泡沫時代以來的重要區間上緣，可能成為AI泡沫破裂的導火線。
Sharma 認為，政府以高利率發行大量債券所產生的「擠出效應」，正逐步推高AI企業取得債券及股權融資的成本。
目前AI應用每年營收估計約2000億美元，相較之下，資料中心等相關基礎設施支出已超過1兆美元，兩者之間存在龐大落差，而這項資金缺口高度仰賴外部融資。一旦長天期利率快速攀升，可能直接影響AI產業持續擴大投資的速度。

本輪債務過剩集中政府　AI泡沫結構出現變化

Sharma 回顧過去300年的重大資產泡沫指出，泡沫通常在核心企業的借貸成本大幅上升後走向破裂。從19世紀鐵路泡沫，到現代央行體系下的歷次市場泡沫，都可看到類似模式。
一般而言，市場狂熱期間，企業會大量舉債押注熱門產業或投資題材，隨著通膨及利率攀升，融資成本上升最終刺破泡沫；之後政府才介入，透過承接債務及刺激經濟來穩定市場。
但Sharma認為，這一次的情況有所不同。
自2020年代以來，美國財政赤字持續約占GDP的6%，超過此前數十年的平均水準一倍以上。與此同時，美國家庭及企業長期並未大幅增加槓桿。
直到過去一年，隨著科技巨頭逐漸消耗手中現金盈餘，才開始透過大規模舉債支應龐大的AI基礎建設投資。不過，以這些大型企業的規模而言，目前槓桿水準仍處於可控範圍。
Sharma指出，因此本輪週期真正大幅累積的債務，目前主要集中在政府部門，而風險可能正從負債最嚴重的地方開始浮現。

政府發債產生擠出效應　10年期美債5%成重要關卡

隨著政府債務快速膨脹，美國債券市場的「擠出效應」也開始受到關注。
美國公共債務未償餘額已達40.05兆美元，首次突破40兆美元；本財政年度利息支出達1.17兆美元。與此同時，30年期美債殖利率升至5.32%，創2007年以來新高。
過去5年，美國公共債務利息支出已翻倍至超過GDP的3%，不僅創下美國紀錄，也是主要已開發經濟體中增幅最快、占比最高的國家。
財政壓力與能源價格上漲，進一步推高全球債券殖利率，而無風險利率走高，也會同步增加AI企業的融資成本。AI產業目前正是新發公司債的重要需求來源之一。
Sharma因此將10年期美債殖利率視為關鍵觀察指標。他認為，一旦殖利率「決定性突破5%」，將代表更高利率環境進一步確立，AI大型投資計畫的融資難度也會隨之升高。
當大型科技企業必須與殖利率超過5%、通膨調整後報酬率超過2.5%的政府公債競逐資金時，部分企業可能難以繼續從債券市場取得所需資金。

AI營收遠低於基礎建設支出　融資缺口成市場隱憂

目前AI應用年營收估計僅約2000億美元，遠低於資料中心等基礎設施超過1兆美元的投資規模。AI企業因此愈來愈需要透過新發債券及股票融資填補資金缺口。
然而，10年期美債殖利率若突破5%，可能同時對債券及股票兩大融資管道形成壓力；此外，該殖利率也將高於美股的盈餘殖利率，歷史上通常不利於股市表現。
若10年期美債殖利率在11月前突破5%，代表半年內上升超過75個基點，而歷史上類似幅度的殖利率快速攀升，都曾終結牛市。
儘管部分分析師認為，殖利率突破5%只代表回到1990年代的水準，當時10年期美債殖利率長期高於5%，美股仍維持強勁表現；但Sharma認為，當時美國的債務結構與如今截然不同。
1990年代的美國以財政盈餘結束10年，而目前美國公眾持有的政府債務已接近GDP的100%，償債成本也遠高於當時。因此，公共部門借貸成本上升，可能更迅速擠壓其他借款人，並對估值已大幅擴張的AI市場形成更大壓力。
在此背景下，後續市場將關注10年期美債殖利率是否、以及以多快速度突破5%，以及利率變化可能對AI資本支出與美股估值帶來的衝擊。

items.title: 美債恐比想像更糟 頂尖經濟學家：殖利率已進入「全面應戰」狀態
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Worsens More Than Expected, Top Economist Says Yields Have Entered a “Full‑Scale Battle” State
paras: 美國公債市場近期浮現令人不安的跡象。布魯金斯學會資深研究員布魯克斯（Robin Brooks）指出，殖利率上升顯示，市場情勢可能比表面看來更加嚴峻。
布魯克斯周二在 Substack 發文表示，美國政策目前已將重點放在防止長期借貸成本急升，並提到美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）正努力將公債買回規模提高一倍。
經濟轉弱 殖利率不降反升
他進一步指出，近期反映經濟活動疲弱的數據，並未像過去一樣帶動長期殖利率下滑，凸顯市場本身的上行壓力有多大。
布魯克斯寫道：「就我所見，長期殖利率已進入各方全面應戰的局面。」
儘管上周五公布的就業報告意外優於預期，但布魯克斯表示，過去一個月其他經濟數據大多不如預期。照理說，市場應因經濟放緩及通膨降溫而推低殖利率，但實際上，殖利率卻持續攀升。
不可否認，美國對伊朗的戰事近幾周也持續升溫。隨著衝突加劇，外交談判又未見進展，油價重新走高，使通膨前景更加惡化。
不過，布魯克斯認為，10 年期美債殖利率的異常走勢，其實透露出「市場對美國公債的需求，比表面看來更為疲弱」。
美國債務規模如今已達 40 兆美元，正逐漸超越人工智慧（AI）熱潮，成為華爾街關注焦點。債務疑慮也不僅限於美國，英國、法國、德國及日本等主要經濟體的公債殖利率同樣大幅攀升。
自新冠疫情以來，各國政府持續支出，彷彿借貸成本仍處於危機時期的低點，並任由財政赤字惡化，彷彿經濟仍亟需緊急刺激措施。
然而，如今的經濟環境已截然不同。為抑制高通膨，利率近年大幅攀升；與此同時，AI 熱潮每年為經濟注入數千億美元資金，使經濟對高利率的敏感度愈來愈低。
RSM 首席經濟學家布魯塞拉斯（Joseph Brusuelas）上月在報告中表示：「債務何時會變得不可持續？當全球金融市場這麼認定時。現在看來，這種情況似乎正在發生。」
傳統買家退場 美債波動加劇
同一時間，美債買方結構也已改變。過去為資金尋找安全停泊處的外國央行及其他機構，在美債市場中的角色逐漸縮小，並愈來愈多轉向黃金等替代性避險資產。
全球最大主權財富基金、管理資產達 2.3 兆美元的挪威銀行投資管理公司（Norges Bank Investment Management），已提議調整債券配置，降低對美債的依賴。
隨著傳統美債買家退場，避險基金已成為市場重要參與者，但這類投資人對價格更加敏感，也加劇債市波動。
這意味著，美國財政部必須提供更具吸引力的殖利率，才能讓債券投資人持續進場。在年度預算赤字朝 2 兆美元邁進、國會議員又未展現控制赤字意願之際，市場對於繼續以如此龐大規模借錢給美國聯邦政府，已日益感到不安。
布魯克斯認為，殖利率與經濟數據脫鉤，背後有一個「顯而易見的解釋」，也就是市場更加關注財政赤字前景，因此推升長期利率。
他補充表示：「美債市場的內在動態，比你想像的更令人憂心。」
不過，也有人將殖利率上升解讀為經濟強勁的跡象。華爾街資深策略師亞德尼（Ed Yardeni）不認同債務危機即將爆發的警告，反而認為殖利率只是回歸全球金融危機及新冠疫情前的正常水準；這兩場危機曾開啟超低利率時代。
亞德尼近日在報告中補充，當前美國債務的發展軌跡確實不可持續，但所謂的「債券義警」似乎尚未對此感到憂慮，至少目前還沒有。
亞德尼預測：「美債殖利率仍處於大致符合經濟健康狀況的區間，我們預期 10 年期美債殖利率將維持在 4.00% 至 5.00% 之間。」
paras_en: The U.S. Treasury market has recently shown unsettling signs. Robin Brooks, a senior researcher at the Brookings Institution, points out that rising yields indicate the market situation may be tougher than it appears on the surface.

Brooks wrote on Substack on Tuesday that current U.S. policy is focused on preventing a sharp jump in long‑term borrowing costs, and noted that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is working to double the scale of Treasury buybacks.
Economic slowdown: Yields rise instead of falling

He further noted that recent data reflecting weak economic activity have not driven long‑term yields down as they have in the past, highlighting how strong the upward pressure from the market itself is.
Brooks wrote: “From what I see, long‑term yields have entered a situation where all sides are fully engaged in a battle.”

Even though last Friday’s jobs report came out better than expected, Brooks says most other economic data over the past month have missed forecasts. In theory, a slowing economy and cooling inflation should push yields lower, but in reality yields keep climbing.

It cannot be denied that U.S. hostilities with Iran have also been heating up in recent weeks. As the conflict intensifies and diplomatic talks stall, oil prices have risen again, worsening the inflation outlook.
Nevertheless, Brooks believes the anomalous movement of the 10‑year Treasury yield actually reveals that “the market’s demand for U.S. Treasuries is weaker than it appears on the surface.”

U.S. debt now stands at $40 trillion, gradually overtaking the AI boom as Wall Street’s focal point. Debt concerns are not limited to the United States; major economies such as the United Kingdom, France, Germany and Japan are also seeing their sovereign yields climb sharply.

Since the COVID‑19 pandemic, governments worldwide have kept spending, as if borrowing costs remain at crisis‑low levels, allowing fiscal deficits to worsen, as if economies still urgently need stimulus measures.

However, today’s economic environment is entirely different. To curb high inflation, rates have risen sharply in recent years; at the same time, the AI boom injects hundreds of billions of dollars into the economy each year, making the economy less sensitive to high rates.

Joseph Brusuelas, chief economist at RSM, said in a report last month: “When will debt become unsustainable? When the global financial markets collectively decide so. It now appears that this is happening.”
Traditional buyers are exiting, increasing Treasury volatility

At the same time, the structure of Treasury buyers has shifted. Foreign central banks and other institutions that once sought safe havens are shrinking their role in the Treasury market and increasingly turning to alternatives such as gold.
Norges Bank Investment Management, the world’s largest sovereign wealth fund with $2.3 trillion in assets, has proposed adjusting its bond allocation to reduce reliance on U.S. Treasuries.
As traditional Treasury buyers exit, hedge funds have become key market participants, but these investors are more price‑sensitive, amplifying bond‑market volatility.

This means the Treasury Department must offer more attractive yields to keep investors buying. With the annual budget deficit moving toward $2 trillion and Congress showing little willingness to curb the deficit, the market is growing increasingly uneasy about continuing to lend such massive sums to the U.S. federal government.
Brooks says the decoupling of yields from economic data has an “obvious explanation”: the market is focusing more on the fiscal‑deficit outlook, which pushes long‑term rates higher.
He added: “The underlying dynamics of the Treasury market are more concerning than you think.”

However, some interpret the rise in yields as a sign of a strong economy. Wall Street veteran strategist Ed Yardeni disagrees with warnings of an imminent debt crisis, arguing instead that yields are simply returning to pre‑COVID‑19 and pre‑global‑financial‑crisis normal levels, which had ushered in an era of ultra‑low rates.
Yardeni recently added in a report that while the current trajectory of U.S. debt is indeed unsustainable, the so‑called “bond vigilantes” do not yet appear worried about it, at least not for now.
Yardeni predicts: “Treasury yields remain broadly in line with a healthy economy; we expect the 10‑year Treasury yield to stay between 4.00% and 5.00%.”

items.title: AI先進封裝需求升溫 長電科技擬募資65億人民幣擴產、2026年資本支出上看100億人民幣
items.title_en: Rising Demand for Advanced Packaging in AI Spurs JCET to Seek 6.5 Billion RMB Funding, 2026 Capex May Reach 10 Billion RMB
paras: 2026年09月08日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 中國封測廠上半年獲利普遍成長，21家先進封裝概念公司中，20家營收成長、18家獲利增加，顯示封測產業景氣已由需求題材逐步反映至財報。但真正決定先進封裝能否成為下一階段獲利來源的，不是擴產金額，而是客戶驗證、良率、量產進度與產能利用率。
長電科技JCET Group(600584-CN)宣布透過私募增資籌資65億元人民幣，用於擴充先進封裝產能。花旗認為，此次籌資反映公司即將進入新一輪資本支出週期，2026年資本支出可能超過100億元人民幣，優於市場共識預估78億，且2027年至2028年並有望打破預期持續增加，以掌握中國AI帶動的先進封裝需求。
市場共識也同步反映部分核心業務轉強。從2026會計年度第3季預估來看，母公司JCET業務營收預估由32.51億元人民幣上修至35.26億元，上修8.4%；新加坡封測子公司星科金朋(STATS ChipPAC)營收預估則由39.74億元大幅提高至47.23億元，上修18.8%。
第4季延續類似趨勢。JCET業務營收預估上修5.3%至35.20億元人民幣；星科金朋(STATS ChipPAC)營收預估更大幅上修24.0%至49.88億元。
公司表示，2025年先進封裝服務營收達270億元人民幣，創歷史新高，占全年營收388.7億元人民幣近7成，顯示先進封裝已成為公司主要營收來源。
近期長電科技在先進封裝技術取得進展，已與合作夥伴完成高深寬比矽穿孔(TSV)樣品製作，進一步補強2.5D、3D先進封裝及矽中介層(Silicon Interposer)製造能力，鎖定AI、高效能運算(HPC)與高頻寬記憶體(HBM)需求。
此次TSV直徑為1.5微米、深度17微米，深寬比達11.3:1，可用於2.5D矽中介層、3D晶片堆疊及異質Chiplet整合。目前技術仍處於樣品及工程驗證階段，尚未進入大量生產。
隨著GPU、ASIC與HBM整合需求升溫，矽中介層市場也快速擴張。研調機構SNS Insider預估，全球矽中介層市場規模將由2025年的40億美元增至2035年的140億美元，2026年至2035年年複合成長率達13.38%。長電科技正建立完整的矽中介層製造能力，若TSV技術後續順利完成驗證並進入量產，將有機會進一步切入AI與HBM帶動的2.5D、3D先進封裝商機。

paras_en: September 8, 2026 (You Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Chinese semiconductor packaging firms saw profit growth in the first half of the year; among 21 advanced‑packaging concept companies, 20 posted revenue growth and 18 increased earnings, indicating that the industry’s recovery is now reflected in financial results. However, the real drivers of whether advanced packaging can become the next profit source are not the scale of capacity expansion but customer validation, yield, mass‑production schedule and capacity utilization.

JCET Group (600584‑CN) announced a private placement to raise 6.5 billion RMB for expanding advanced‑packaging capacity. Citi believes the raise signals a new capital‑expenditure cycle, with 2026 capex potentially exceeding 10 billion RMB—well above the market consensus of 7.8 billion RMB—and that 2027‑2028 spending could continue to rise, capturing AI‑driven advanced‑packaging demand in China.

The market consensus also reflects a strengthening of core businesses. For the third quarter of fiscal 2026, the parent JCET’s revenue estimate was lifted from 3.251 billion RMB to 3.526 billion RMB, an 8.4% increase, while its Singapore packaging subsidiary STATS ChipPAC’s revenue outlook was raised sharply from 3.974 billion RMB to 4.723 billion RMB, an 18.8% uplift.
The same upward trend continued into Q4. JCET’s revenue estimate was revised up 5.3% to 3.520 billion RMB, and STATS ChipPAC’s estimate was boosted 24.0% to 4.988 billion RMB.

The company said its advanced‑packaging services revenue reached 27 billion RMB in 2025, a record high, accounting for nearly 70% of total 2025 revenue of 38.87 billion RMB, showing that advanced packaging has become its main revenue driver.

Recently JCET made progress in advanced‑packaging technology, completing high‑aspect‑ratio silicon‑through‑via (TSV) samples with a partner, further strengthening its 2.5D, 3D advanced‑packaging and silicon‑interposer manufacturing capabilities to target AI, high‑performance computing (HPC) and high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) demand.

The TSVs have a 1.5‑micron diameter, 17‑micron depth and an aspect ratio of 11.3:1, suitable for 2.5D silicon interposers, 3D chip stacking and heterogeneous chiplet integration. The technology is still at the sample and engineering‑validation stage and has not entered mass production yet.

As GPU, ASIC and HBM integration demand heats up, the silicon‑interposer market is expanding rapidly. Research firm SNS Insider projects the global silicon‑interposer market to grow from $4 billion in 2025 to $14 billion in 2035, with a compound annual growth rate of 13.38% from 2026 to 2035. JCET is building a full silicon‑interposer capability and, if its TSV technology passes validation and reaches volume production, it could capture additional AI‑ and HBM‑driven 2.5D and 3D advanced‑packaging opportunities.
